# Native energy analysis

This operator runs the original nmecr R package against one explicitly selected BuildingSync energy stream and a complete observed-weather CSV. It keeps the original XML, selection, weather, timezone decisions, native frames, fitted models, coefficients, statistics, reporting predictions, uncertainty calculations, plots, logs and package identities together.


## Owner instruction: inspect the actual outgoing product and every attachment

This owner instruction applies to every current, future, resumed and delegated worker, across providers and local or cloud runtimes. Before calling a customer/prospect-facing application, website, dashboard, demo, report, presentation or export ready, open/run/render the exact outgoing version, look at the rendered screen or its actual screenshots, and operate the important user controls. Inspect the actual screenshare width and narrow/mobile width where relevant, populated/empty/loading/error states, downloads/exports and reopening. Capturing screenshots without viewing them is insufficient. Code review, DOM counts, HTTP 200, unit checks and another worker's approval do not replace seeing the actual product.

The same requirement covers **every outgoing attachment**. Open the complete original file in the application the recipient will use. Inspect document pages, tables, slides, plots and printable/exported views; follow the useful controls and links; download and reopen the complete delivery. Watch final video and listen to final audio when those media are included, checking readable content, actual playback, intelligibility and natural voice quality. Keep the viewed or played edition tied to the exact file being delivered.

Fix broken, unstyled, cramped, clipped, overflowing or unreadable output within the authorized work before presenting it. Use plain industrial software design: readable tables, clear hierarchy, consistent typography and spacing, restrained controls, useful labels and responsive layouts. Preserve real workflows, source data and computations. Inspection must lead directly to repairs and must not replace implementation/integration or become repeated checking. Keep validation focused on the actual remaining risk; do not run broad suites or build a verification product.

Include this complete instruction in delegated assignments and the active owner-controlled policy, boot, build and receiving guidance those workers actually read. Preserve all other owner controls and original operation identities. Leave historical records and third-party/vendor policies intact. Do not force restarts, create watchers or revive owner-stopped work. When a runtime is unavailable, join the existing equipped receiver with the complete exact version and opening steps, review its actual rendered result, and continue independent implementation while it runs.

Owner instruction and coordinated propagation: https://tokenjunkielabs.slack.com/archives/C0BU51F1PL3/p1791881496221999 . The all-attachments and final-media clarification is retained in that original owner thread. Project-specific deadlines continue to apply to their actual named projects.

### Inspect the analytical outputs that the recipient will use

Open the actual selected run in **Native analysis** using the retained application and original workspace. Inspect the complete stream preview, literal meter boundaries/units, supplied weather reference and model options before operating the original run or same-input continuation. While the original job progresses, inspect its real queued/running and retained outcome display; preserve forms and completed model checkpoints. Use the original active worker and its lease.

Open every delivered analytical report and plot. At the recipient's desktop/screenshare and relevant narrow view, check legible source/model labels, axes and units, full time range, legends, actual warnings and failed/inapplicable model outcomes. Inspect the actual content of the saved HTML, SVG/PDF or image files in their appropriate renderer. Read complete CSV/JSON frames in the receiving data workflow and reopen the original R objects with the documented native R environment. A retained error report is opened as the actual outcome; never substitute a fabricated curve or summary.

Operate the complete-file downloads and reopen their retained identities. Then follow the selected model outputs through the complete workspace/application export and independent receiving; confirm that the saved edition opens its original model state and useful output links. Where the outgoing handover includes narrated or recorded media, watch/listen to the final file and verify the underlying analytical labels and meaning as well as playback.

If this host cannot open the result, join the existing equipped receiving owner with the complete exact application/project/input/output files, original run ID and launch instructions, and the full owner rule above. The producer views the actual returned screens and attachment renderings and makes the specific required repair. Runtime restoration and source engineering continue alongside this receiving; preserve the original analysis inputs, model outcomes and operating ownership.

## Runtime installation

The application needs Python 3.11 or newer on a POSIX host, R, and the imports declared in analysis-dependencies.json. R is a host runtime; queued analysis jobs do not install software. Install into an owned R library:

    python3 install_analysis.py --directory /absolute/analysis-runtime/source --library /absolute/analysis-runtime/library --install-dependencies

The installer receives the public source archive at nmecr commit 343146d7a1e20d027e6ca48bd7ca2b38c646592a, verifies every one of its 102 original Git blobs against nmecr-source-index.json, retains the complete source, installs the native package and saves original source plus installed-file identities. An already received original archive can be supplied with --archive. --rscript chooses an existing host Rscript. --install-dependencies authorizes this host setup to install missing R imports from CRAN; omit it when the host already supplies them.

Set R_LIBS_USER to that owned library before starting the application. AUDIT_RSCRIPT can name an explicit Rscript executable or a host's private runtime launcher. The package version is 1.0.18. Its original monthly interval joins require dplyr 1.1.0 or newer. Full dependency versions, sessionInfo(), commands and original installation logs remain in the case.

On a host with an existing supported R installation, the source installer needs no compiler for nmecr itself. Some imported packages contain compiled native code; provide the host's ordinary binary packages or compiler toolchain for those dependencies. The installer preserves native installation errors in their complete logs.

## Choosing the source

Select a source and revision, one building, one scenario, one resource, one exact stream, Total reading type and its original energy units. Every reading must resolve to that same combination. Original decimal literals and interval boundaries stay in selection.json and original.xml. A floating-point frame is created only for the native R computation.

The seven streams in the published combined L100 + BSyncr example include electricity Total, Peak and Cost; natural-gas Total and Cost; and onsite-generation Total and Cost. Only its three Total energy streams enter this energy model path. Peak kW and currency amounts remain separate quantities. Volume-based fuels require a documented original calorific conversion before entering an energy model.

The published example contains an address/coordinate conflict and no UTC offsets in its timestamps. The operator must retain a chosen timezone and weather-station rationale with this example. The software preserves original coordinates and never silently geocodes a replacement.

## Weather

Attach the full original UTF-8 CSV and supply its name, source URL or acquisition reference, SHA-256 and byte length. Default column names are time and temp. An explicit mapping can choose the original source's names:

    {
      "sourceTimezone": "UTC",
      "weatherTimezone": "UTC",
      "weatherColumns": {"time": "DATE", "temp": "TEMP", "station": "STATION"},
      "weatherUnits": "F",
      "weatherInterval": "Daily"
    }

This is a format example. Use the timezones, units and interval stated by the actual source. Temperatures in C are converted to F in the native frame while the original values remain intact. Weather must be at least as frequent as the meter interval, cover its entire start-inclusive/end-exclusive period, and have no missing or overlapping intervals within that period. Missing sentinel values can be declared through weatherMissingValues. The operator never chooses a nearest observation to fill a gap.

The original weather file may contain additional complete periods for explicit normalization. Complete original rows remain in weather.csv; weather-native.csv records the actual Fahrenheit conversion and original CSV line number. Station/source information remains in weather-metadata.json.

## Model options

models chooses from Mean, SLR, 3PC, 3PH, 4P, 5P, HDD, CDD, HDD-CDD, TOW and TOWT. The default runs all eleven and returns an explicit applicability result for each. TOW/TOWT support submonthly data; HDD/CDD models support Daily/Monthly data. There is no automatic substitution for an unsupported interval.

interval can explicitly select 15-min, Hourly, Daily or Monthly matching the original meter interval. Energy is never silently resampled. Missing meter ends require an explicit endPolicy: next-reading with lastEnd, or frequency with a supported interval. The default requires original ends. Offset-free timestamps require sourceTimezone/weatherTimezone. Ambiguous or nonexistent local clock times require an actual original offset.

modelArguments forwards the original assign_model_inputs controls:
has_temp_knots_defined, equal_temp_segment_points, temp_segments_numeric, temp_knots_value, initial_breakpoints, occupancy_threshold and day_normalized. The energy path leaves demand timescale_days unset. balancePoint specifies the real degree-day base in F, default 65; existing daily degree days are aggregated through the original package. Monthly SLR/HDD/CDD use physical predictors after date-boundary metadata is removed from their regression inputs. The complete native frame remains retained.

baseline and reporting each have start and end, using whole original intervals and at least three readings. They must be disjoint. Reporting-period predictions and nmecr uncertainty are calculated only when both periods are explicitly selected. normalization also selects a start/end window from complete supplied observed weather and fits the actual reporting-period model before calling the native normalized-savings API. These are analytical comparisons of the supplied periods; no intervention is inferred from a date split.

confidenceLevel defaults to 90. seed defaults to 20261012. timeoutSeconds defaults to 3600 and can be 30 through 86400. allowNegativePredictions forwards the original native option; the package applies it to TOW/TOWT. Mean prediction uses stats::predict on its actual native intercept model because the upstream prediction dispatcher has no Mean branch. All calls, original fitted objects and decisions remain in the output.

## Retention and continuation

The workspace worker holds operation.lock through the actual R lifetime. Direct run_analysis calls use that same lock. A supplied lease_fd is inherited by every native subprocess, so a lost controller cannot start a second writer while the original R process is still active.

Input identity includes the original source, selection, weather, options and engine source identities. A complete cached result is reused only after every retained output matches its recorded length and SHA-256. Every model has its own retained terminal checkpoint and complete object; an interrupted catalogue resumes from valid completed model checkpoints.

metadata.terminal distinguishes a complete original outcome from a recoverable native interruption. metadata.resumable is true for unfinished runtime/native failures. Installing the runtime or resuming after a timeout uses the same analysis identifier and original input. Immutable input errors require a new corrected selection. A completed native model failure remains its actual outcome; change model options intentionally to run another analysis.

Statuses are complete, partial, failed, needs-input, needs-runtime and running. A partial result contains successful fitted models alongside actual native failures. Its original warnings/errors remain accessible. Signed NDBE/NMBE and all native statistics are preserved. JSON represents non-finite numbers as null; full RDS, R text and CSV preserve the original native forms.

## Native receiving operation

The accompanying receiving programme uses the complete original BuildingSync example and acquired observed weather, then the original package's published datasets for daily model coverage. It retains original source identities, full input frames and every original model outcome. It exercises actual native APIs and the application's lease/continuation path. Model convergence and uncertainty failures are recorded as native outcomes, with successful results preserved.

The official sources are https://github.com/kW-Labs/nmecr and https://kw-labs.github.io/nmecr/. The complete bsyncr originals are reviewed for interoperability; this implementation selects original streams explicitly instead of using bsyncr's implicit first-resource/all-readings selection.

## Selected weather normalization

Normalized savings uses the selected balance point and negative-prediction policy consistently with the fitted models and reporting predictions. The installed nmecr 1.0.18 function aggregates normalization weather with a default 65°F balance point and invokes its default prediction policy. The application instead supplies the complete native weather aggregation with the operator's selected balance point, explicit inclusive start and exclusive end, and unchanged observed timestamps. It then calls the complete pinned upstream normalization body through two documented input seams: the prepared native weather and the same native prediction method used for reporting. Every original savings and uncertainty expression is retained. The package itself stays unchanged.

The original upstream prediction dispatcher has no Mean branch. Mean predictions use `stats::predict` on the actual fitted native intercept model, with the selected monthly day normalization and negative-prediction policy. Other models use `nmecr::calculate_model_predictions`.

Each model retains the original and adapted function representations, selected input policy, complete original weather, native aggregated weather, both complete prediction series and the full native normalization return. Receiving checks the complete selected weather window, native interval boundaries and prediction rows. A native aggregation that omits a selected period reports a normalization error while retaining the fitted models, statistics and all original output. Undefined uncertainty arithmetic stays in the original RDS/R/CSV output; its JSON representation follows the existing non-finite-value policy.

The complete Python analysis identity includes both the R engine and Python wrapper hashes. Existing completed or interrupted model directories retain their original engine identity. Same-ID analysis.resume continues unchanged source, weather, options and engine after a recoverable runtime interruption. A changed engine requires a deliberately identified new analysis input and directory, preserving the prior outputs; the catalogue's explicitly versioned engine cases remain separate original inputs. The per-model normalization checkpoint also names `nmecr-1.0.18-selected-weather-v1`.

Original implementation: [normalization](https://github.com/kW-Labs/nmecr/blob/343146d7a1e20d027e6ca48bd7ca2b38c646592a/R/normalized_savings_and_uncertainty.R), [weather aggregation](https://github.com/kW-Labs/nmecr/blob/343146d7a1e20d027e6ca48bd7ca2b38c646592a/R/aggregate.R), and [prediction](https://github.com/kW-Labs/nmecr/blob/343146d7a1e20d027e6ca48bd7ca2b38c646592a/R/calculate_model_predictions.R), all pinned to the installed original source. The full upstream MIT notice accompanies the adapted function.

# Installed recipient review in Audit Exchange

Operation: AUDIT-RECIPIENT-INSTALLED-OPERATOR-24EA-20261013.

This is the installed author side of the existing complete recipient workflow. Use the original Audit workspace and its retained complete export. The recipient edits the standalone manuscript; the author reviews and accepts it through the same native review.save requests used by the command-line helper. No replacement author workspace or parallel review store is introduced.

## Author and recipient course

Open the original Audit Exchange server and connect to its actual workspace ID. Enter the operator name. In **Export and receive → Recipient review**, choose an existing complete workspace or application export and select **Prepare complete recipient editor**. The result is retained in this native workspace and downloaded as Audit_Recipient_Complete.zip. Extract the whole archive, keeping original-review.zip and the adjacent script, stylesheet and hash implementation with Audit_Recipient_Review.html.

The recipient opens the actual HTML, inspects the complete source, writes review proposals, saves immutable manuscript editions, and downloads the complete return. The unchanged offline guide AUDIT_RECIPIENT_REVIEW.md describes its editable working copy, reopening and source selection. The original author is not modified by an offline proposal.

Back in the same original author workspace, select the whole returned ZIP and **Retain complete return**. The stage action checks every manuscript edition and exact original bytes and requires that this author actually retains the enclosed workspace/application export. The retained return receives its original native export ID. Choose it and **Preview every returned review**. Inspect pending and already accepted rows, source/revision, assignee, complete note and original request IDs. The full preview JSON is downloadable; its disclosure is populated only while open.

Apply only the current preview with the same operator. A changed return, workspace version or operator makes the preview inapplicable. Each pending review is accepted through the original Workspace.perform API, original UUID, full request and version CAS. Previously accepted rows retain their native IDs and original requests. The final native custody archive contains the original return, complete source binding, selected preview, original outer request, every retained review request/result, and the complete accepted result. All exports remain available in the original workspace and travel in its complete application handover.

## Interrupted replies and partial acceptance

The existing application retains the complete original mutation before dispatch in its IndexedDB journal. If a reply is unavailable, keep the original request and use **Recover original request**. The original native request ID and full envelope are replayed. An accepted outer request returns its native saved result before any current-version check or local temporary-file requirement.

A preview does not replace a request. If the process stops after accepting some reviews, those exact native requests can be rediscovered from the original requests table. Their input records, deterministic IDs and committed versions reconstruct the original full envelopes; the unchanged native replay verifies each reconstruction before local custody is republished. A retained successful receipt with no original native operation is an error requiring reconciliation, not permission to create another review.

A concurrent native change can refuse a pending review after an earlier prefix was accepted. Keep that prefix and the complete original request. Once the original request is definitively refused, close it with the existing refused-request control, refresh and deliberately review a new preview. The already accepted review identities are reused. Do not edit the old request's UUID or expectedVersion and do not delete native history to force acceptance.

The complete supplied preview is structurally and cryptographically validated before either its immutable preview file or outer request file is published. Malformed preview content cannot occupy the path for a valid selected preview. The original helper applies the same pure validator before its own publication.

## Native, CLI and configured tools

The existing native action API adds:

| Action | Inputs beyond original request fields | Result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| recipient.prepare | exportId, expectedSha256, actor, note | Retained complete editor archive and original source/delivery identity |
| recipient.stage | name, contentBase64, expectedSha256, actor, note | Retained complete return and manuscript/edition identity |
| recipient.preview | returnId, operator | Full original preview and selected return ID |
| recipient.apply | returnId, previewSha256, complete preview object, actor, note | Exact accepted result and complete native custody archive |

Mutations retain requestId and expectedVersion in the original envelope. The existing action command, dynamic catalog, MCP tools and configured merchant mappings expose these same actions; no additional CLI is needed. Tool names are audit_recipient_prepare, audit_recipient_stage, audit_recipient_preview and audit_recipient_apply. Configured file import supports kind recipient and reads the existing pinned whole local file before staging it. Ordinary inline command-envelope limits remain unchanged; use the existing configured file route for a large complete ZIP.

The stage input limit is 256 MiB. Complete original source-package and manuscript limits remain the original helper's bounds. No source bytes, original manuscript editions or accepted request history are silently omitted to fit a route.

## Continue the actual completed case through the installed product

First complete the original AUDIT_RECIPIENT_RECEIVING.py operation and retain its entire directory plus COMPLETE.json archive. This following course does not bootstrap or replace that case. It acquires the original predecessor operation lease as well as its own following lease, verifies the completed source/return/archive and opens the same original author directory.

Run from the installed complete source:

    python AUDIT_RECIPIENT_INSTALLED_RECEIVING.py \
      --completed-recipient /absolute/original-recipient-operation \
      --directory /absolute/installed-recipient-following \
      --chromium /absolute/verified/chromium \
      --playwright-module /absolute/verified/playwright

Use --node only to select the actual maintained Node executable. The complete SOURCE_FILES inventory must be installed first. Keep the following journal outside both the application source and original native workspace. The original configured Playwright and Chromium must already be available on the selected host; this receiver makes no paid browser request or browser installation.

The course operates the installed controls against the original server. It prepares the complete editor, stages the original returned manuscript, previews it, changes the operator to exercise stale-preview disabling, accepts the original preview while retaining an unavailable accepted response, and recovers that exact request through the visible original request-file control. Request bodies are fsynced before dispatch. Restart restores original bodies rather than inventing new operations. It downloads whole source/return/custody, reloads desktop and narrow screens, checks exact native replay without a new version, exports the complete application and independently receives/reopens/reexports it with the unchanged native receiver.

This course reuses the reviews already accepted by the original recipient operation. It verifies that their native records remain unchanged. Its new native rows are additive installed preparation, staging, outer custody and export requests. Concurrent unrelated native work is preserved; where a comparison can no longer establish the exact selected course, the same journal remains for reconciliation.

On restart, the course first downloads the actual complete pending request from the existing installed recovery controls. It requires exact equality with this course’s retained prepare, stage or apply request and recovers that original action before revisiting earlier accepted steps. A later pending stage or apply therefore remains authoritative; it is never replaced by a replay of preparation. An unrelated or missing original request journal is retained for reconciliation rather than cleared or assigned another ID.

The first complete author-after snapshot is retained once. A continuation verifies its original reviews and accepted-request ancestry and reuses the exact full application-export request, even when that request already advanced the workspace before interruption. A retained browser result is verified and reused. A retained RUN_RESULT takes a packaging-only continuation, so browser logs are not changed after the archive inventory is frozen. The inherited lease stays open through Node and every observed owned Chromium descendant. The child exec wrapper restores the original signal mask before starting Node; parent interruption drains owned processes before lease release. The original HTTP request threads drain before closing the workspace.

The final archive contains the entire predecessor archive, complete current application source, exact inputs, original requests and replies, browser downloads and images, source/native custody, complete author application and independently received application. COMPLETE.json deliberately leaves renderedRecipientReady false until the producing operator performs the visual and attachment review below.

## Actual rendered and attachment review

Before calling a client-facing application, demo, report, presentation or export ready, the producing operator must open, run or render the exact outgoing edition, personally look at its screens or real screenshots, and operate its important controls. Review the actual desktop/screenshare and relevant narrow/mobile layouts, populated, empty, loading and error states, downloads and reopening. Screenshot capture without looking at the images is insufficient. Code review, DOM counts, HTTP success, grammar checks and peer approval do not replace seeing the product.

Open, see, play or use every outgoing attachment as its recipient would. Inspect the complete editor in its real browser, open the manuscript and whole original source, extract and open the complete return and custody archives, and reopen the delivered native application through its actual receiver. For any video or audio, use available generative media and natural quality speech as appropriate and watch/listen to the final export.

Repair broken, unstyled, cramped, clipped, overflowing or unreadable output within this authorized work. Use neutral grayscale, plain readable tables, clear hierarchy, consistent typography and spacing, restrained controls, useful labels and responsive layout. Preserve the real workflow, data and computation. Do not turn this into endless rechecking, introduce a verification product, force restarts or watchers, or revive stopped work. Keep the original owner controls and vendor policies.

If this host cannot execute, hand the whole source, exact original case selection and this command to the existing equipped owner. Preserve any unknown process or mutation outcome and reconcile its original handle before another attempt. Return the actual generated images and attachments for personal inspection; source publication alone is not rendered completion.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Continue the completed original recipient case through its installed author controls."""
from __future__ import annotations
import argparse
import base64
import copy
import fcntl
import hashlib
import os
from pathlib import Path
import signal
import sys
import threading
import zipfile

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(HERE))
import AUDIT_RECIPIENT_RECEIVING as original
import audit_recipient_review as recipient
from application import AuditServer
from common import AuditError, canonical, digest, require
from workspace import Workspace

OPERATION = "AUDIT-RECIPIENT-INSTALLED-OPERATOR-24EA-20261013"
class OwnedServer(AuditServer):
    # Keep the original handler but drain accepted request threads before native close.
    daemon_threads = False
    block_on_close = True

def retain_file(source, target):
    source, target = Path(source), Path(target)
    expected = original.identity(source)
    target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    if target.exists():
        require(original.identity(target) == expected, "installed_file", "Preserve the different original file.")
        return expected
    temporary = target.with_name("." + target.name + ".pending-" + str(os.getpid()))
    try:
        with temporary.open("xb") as output, source.open("rb") as stream:
            for chunk in iter(lambda: stream.read(4 * 1024 * 1024), b""):
                output.write(chunk)
            output.flush(); os.fsync(output.fileno())
        require(original.identity(temporary) == expected and original.identity(source) == expected,
                "installed_file", "A complete original selected file changed.")
        try: os.link(temporary, target)
        except FileExistsError:
            require(original.identity(target) == expected, "installed_file", "An earlier complete file differs.")
        fd = os.open(target.parent, os.O_RDONLY)
        try: os.fsync(fd)
        finally: os.close(fd)
    finally:
        if temporary.exists(): temporary.unlink()
    return expected

def verify_browser(root, selection):
    result = original.read_json(root / "BROWSER_RESULT.json")
    require(result["input"] == {"schema": "commons.audit-recipient-installed-browser-input.v1",
            "selectionSha256": digest(original.data(selection)), "workspaceId": selection["workspaceId"]},
            "installed_browser", "The completed browser used another selected original.")
    for row in result["files"]:
        name = Path(row["path"])
        require(not name.is_absolute() and ".." not in name.parts, "installed_browser", "Keep safe original member paths.")
        require(original.identity(root / name) == {key: row[key] for key in ("bytes", "sha256")},
                "installed_browser", "A completed browser member differs.")
    return result

def snapshot(workspace):
    with workspace.connect() as db:
        db.execute("BEGIN")
        value, objects = workspace._snapshot(db)
    return value

def main(argv=None):
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    for name in ("completed-recipient", "directory", "chromium", "playwright-module"):
        p.add_argument("--" + name, required=True)
    p.add_argument("--node", default="node")
    args = p.parse_args(argv)
    predecessor = Path(args.completed_recipient).expanduser().resolve()
    root = Path(args.directory).expanduser().resolve()
    require(root != HERE and HERE not in root.parents and predecessor != root
            and predecessor not in root.parents and root not in predecessor.parents,
            "installed_directory", "Use a separate following journal and preserve the completed predecessor.")
    require((predecessor / "operation.lock").is_file(), "installed_predecessor", "Use the completed original receiving directory.")
    root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True, mode=0o700)
    with (predecessor / "operation.lock").open("a+b") as predecessor_lock, (root / "operation.lock").open("a+b") as lock:
        fcntl.flock(predecessor_lock, fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
        fcntl.flock(lock, fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
        prior = original.read_json(predecessor / "COMPLETE.json")
        run = original.read_json(predecessor / "RUN_RESULT.json")
        require(prior["operation"] == original.OPERATION and run["native"] == "complete"
                and prior["input"] == run["input"], "installed_predecessor", "Wait for the complete original recipient operation.")
        require(original.identity(prior["archive"]["path"]) == {k: prior["archive"][k] for k in ("bytes", "sha256")},
                "installed_predecessor", "The whole completed original archive differs.")
        directory = Path(run["input"]["workspace"]).resolve()
        require((directory / "audit-exchange.sqlite").is_file() and directory != root
                and root not in directory.parents and directory not in root.parents,
                "installed_workspace", "Continue the same original native author.")
        return_path = predecessor / "browser" / "Audit_Recipient_Return.zip"
        raw, source, draft, manuscript, kinds = recipient.read_return(return_path)
        require(manuscript["manuscriptId"] == run["accepted"]["manuscriptId"]
                and manuscript["source"]["workspaceId"] == run["input"]["workspaceId"],
                "installed_predecessor", "The original complete return belongs to another case.")
        declared = original.read_json(HERE / "SOURCE_FILES.json")["files"]
        require(isinstance(declared, list) and len(declared) == len(set(declared)),
                "installed_source", "Use the full original application inventory.")
        rows = []
        for name in declared:
            relative = Path(name)
            require(not relative.is_absolute() and ".." not in relative.parts, "installed_source", "Use safe complete source members.")
            rows.append({"path": name, **original.identity(HERE / relative)})
        selected = {"operation": OPERATION, "predecessor": str(predecessor),
            "predecessorArchive": {k: prior["archive"][k] for k in ("bytes", "sha256")},
            "workspace": str(directory), "workspaceId": run["input"]["workspaceId"],
            "return": {"bytes": len(raw), "sha256": digest(raw)}, "applicationSource": rows,
            "operator": run["input"]["operator"]}
        original.put(root / "INPUT.json", selected)
        original.OPERATION = OPERATION
        if (root / "COMPLETE.json").exists():
            complete = original.read_json(root / "COMPLETE.json")
            require(complete["input"] == selected and original.identity(complete["archive"]["path"])
                    == {k: complete["archive"][k] for k in ("bytes", "sha256")},
                    "installed_complete", "The retained complete result differs.")
            print(canonical(complete), flush=True); return 0
        if (root / "RUN_RESULT.json").exists():
            require(original.read_json(root / "RUN_RESULT.json")["input"] == selected,
                    "installed_complete", "Keep the original following source selection.")
            print(canonical(original.complete_archive(root, original.read_json(root / "RUN_RESULT.json"))), flush=True)
            return 0
        retain_file(prior["archive"]["path"], root / "Original_Recipient_Complete.zip")
        retain_file(predecessor / "COMPLETE.json", root / "predecessor" / "COMPLETE.json")
        retain_file(predecessor / "RUN_RESULT.json", root / "predecessor" / "RUN_RESULT.json")
        retain_file(return_path, root / "Audit_Recipient_Return.zip")
        for row in rows: retain_file(HERE / row["path"], root / "application" / row["path"])
        author = Workspace(directory)
        try:
            state = author.state()
            require(state["workspaceId"] == selected["workspaceId"]
                    and not any(row["status"] in {"queued", "running"} for row in state["analysisRuns"]),
                    "installed_workspace", "Continue the original idle author after its native owner completes.")
            matches = [row for row in state["exports"] if row["kind"] in {"workspace", "application"} and row["sha256"] == digest(source)]
            require(matches, "installed_source", "The author must retain the exact original recipient export.")
            before_path = root / "AUTHOR_BEFORE.json"
            if not before_path.exists(): original.put(before_path, snapshot(author))
            before = original.read_json(before_path)
            # Original record identities may gain unrelated edits; preserve every earlier
            # accepted request. The following programme itself never changes review records.
            before_ops = {row["id"]: row for row in before["operations"]}
            current_ops = {row["id"]: row for row in snapshot(author)["operations"]}
            require(all(current_ops.get(k) == v for k, v in before_ops.items()),
                    "installed_history", "The current author lost earlier accepted request history.")
            browser_selection = {"workspaceId": state["workspaceId"], "operator": selected["operator"],
                "originalExportId": matches[0]["id"], "returnPath": str(root / "Audit_Recipient_Return.zip"),

                            "--directory", str(browser_root), "--selection", str(root / "BROWSER_SELECTION.json"),
                            "--url", server.url, "--chromium", args.chromium, "--playwright-module", args.playwright_module],
                            HERE, root / "browser.log", (lock.fileno(), predecessor_lock.fileno()))
                    finally:
                        server.shutdown(); thread.join()
                finally: server.server_close()
            browser_result = verify_browser(browser_root, browser_selection)
            for label in ("prepare", "stage", "apply"):
                accepted = original.read_json(browser_root / (label + "-accepted.json"))
                # Exact original replay must leave current version and all histories unchanged.
                version = author.state()["version"]
                replay = author.perform(accepted["request"])
                require(replay["result"] == accepted["result"] and author.state()["version"] == version,
                        "installed_replay", "The original installed request replay changed native history.")
            prepared = browser_result["prepared"]["result"]["archive"]
            prepared_row, prepared_raw = author.download(prepared["id"])
            require(prepared_raw == recipient.read_file(browser_root / "Audit_Recipient_Complete.zip", recipient.MAX_PACKAGE),
                    "installed_download", "The downloaded complete editor differs from native retained bytes.")
            with zipfile.ZipFile(browser_root / "Audit_Recipient_Complete.zip") as complete_editor:
                require(complete_editor.read("original-review.zip") == source,

                manifest = recipient.checked_json(archive.read("manifest.json"))
                require(set(archive.namelist()) == set(manifest["files"]) | {"manifest.json"},

                require(archive.read("recipient-return.zip") == raw
                        and manifest["workspaceId"] == state["workspaceId"], "installed_custody", "The native custody selected another source.")
            current_after = snapshot(author)
            old_reviews = {row["id"]: row for row in before["records"] if row["kind"] == "review"}
            new_reviews = {row["id"]: row for row in current_after["records"] if row["kind"] == "review"}

            retained_ops = {row["id"]: row for row in after["operations"]}
            current_ops = {row["id"]: row for row in current_after["operations"]}
            require(after["workspace"]["workspaceId"] == selected["workspaceId"]
                    and retained_reviews == old_reviews
                    and all(retained_ops.get(k) == v for k, v in before_ops.items())
                    and all(current_ops.get(k) == v for k, v in retained_ops.items()),
                    "installed_history", "The frozen original author outcome lost its review or accepted-request ancestry.")
            export = original.native(author, root, "installed-complete-application", "export.create",
                {"kind": "application", "actor": selected["operator"], "note": "Complete original Audit with installed recipient requests and custody."})
            exported, body = author.download(export["id"])
            recipient.publish(root / "Audit_Installed_Application.zip", body)
            _, exported_snapshot, _, members = recipient.package(body)
            require(all(members["application/" + row["path"]] == (root / "application" / row["path"]).read_bytes() for row in rows),
                    "installed_source", "The complete outgoing application differs from selected source.")
            received = Workspace(root / "received-workspace", "Received installed Audit recipient")
            try:

                     "actor": selected["operator"], "note": "Independent full installed recipient application receiving."})
                comparison = original.compare_received(exported_snapshot, snapshot(received), selected["workspaceId"], digest(body), members)
                next_export = original.native(received, root, "reexport-installed-application", "export.create",

                received_record, received_raw = received.download(next_export["id"])
                recipient.publish(root / "Audit_Installed_Received_Application.zip", received_raw)

                "comparison": comparison, "receivedApplication": received_record, "native": "complete", "renderedRecipientReady": False}
        finally: author.close()
        print(canonical(original.complete_archive(root, result)), flush=True)
        return 0

if __name__ == "__main__":
    signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM, original.interrupted)

def verified_browser(root, selection):

        require(set(archive.namelist()) == set(manifest["files"]) | {"manifest.json"},
                "queue_package", "The complete queue archive inventory differs.")

            body = archive.read(name)

            original.put(root / "BROWSER_SELECTION.json", selection)
            browser_root = root / "browser"
            if not (browser_root / "BROWSER_RESULT.json").exists():
                port_path = root / "SERVER.json"
                port = original.read_json(port_path)["port"] if port_path.exists() else 0
                server = installed.OwnedServer(("127.0.0.1", port), author)
                try:
                    original.put(port_path, {"port": server.server_port, "workspaceId": state["workspaceId"]})
                    thread = threading.Thread(target=server.serve_forever)
                    thread.start()
                    try:
                        original.owned_child([args.node, str(HERE / "AUDIT_RECIPIENT_QUEUE_BROWSER.mjs"),
                            "--directory", str(browser_root), "--selection", str(root / "BROWSER_SELECTION.json"),
                            "--url", server.url, "--chromium", args.chromium, "--playwright-module", args.playwright_module],
                            HERE, root / "browser.log", (lock.fileno(), prior_lock.fileno()))
                    finally:
                        server.shutdown()
                        thread.join()
                finally:
                    server.server_close()
            browser = verified_browser(browser_root, selection)
            for name in ("first", "following", "export"):
                accepted = original.read_json(browser_root / (name + "-accepted.json"))
                version = author.state()["version"]
                replay = author.perform(accepted["request"])
                require(replay["result"] == accepted["result"] and author.state()["version"] == version,
                        "queue_replay", "The exact original queue request replay changed history.")
            queue_record = browser["following"]["result"]["archive"]
            queue = author.perform({"action": "recipient.queue.get", "inputs": {"exportId": queue_record["id"]}})["result"]
            require(len(queue["history"]) == 2 and queue["history"][0]["export"] == browser["first"]["result"]["archive"]
                    and queue["queue"]["edition"] == 2, "queue_history", "Both complete queue editions must remain.")
            package_record, package_bytes = author.download(browser["exported"]["result"]["archive"]["id"])
            require(package_bytes == (browser_root / "Audit_Recipient_Queue_Complete.zip").read_bytes(),
                    "queue_download", "The complete browser download differs from original native bytes.")
            manifest = archive_members(browser_root / "Audit_Recipient_Queue_Complete.zip")
            require(manifest["queueSha256"] == queue_record["sha256"] and all(
                manifest["files"].get("returns/" + r["sha256"] + ".zip") == {"bytes": r["bytes"], "sha256": r["sha256"]}
                for r in returned), "queue_source", "The original complete return selection was lost.")
            after = installed.snapshot(author)
            reviews = lambda value: {r["id"]: r for r in value["records"] if r["kind"] == "review"}
            require(reviews(before) == reviews(after), "queue_scope", "Queue management changed native review decisions.")
            exported = original.native(author, root, "queue-full-application", "export.create",
                {"kind": "application", "actor": specification["operator"], "note": "Complete original Audit with ordered review queue and every selected return."})
            record, body = author.download(exported["id"])
            recipient.publish(root / "Audit_Queue_Application.zip", body)
            _, exported_snapshot, _, members = recipient.package(body)
            require(all(members["application/" + row["path"]] == (root / "application" / row["path"]).read_bytes() for row in rows),
                    "queue_source", "The outgoing complete application source differs.")
            received = Workspace(root / "received-workspace", "Received original Audit queue")
            try:
                outcome = original.native(received, root, "queue-receive-application", "workspace.receive",
                    {"contentBase64": base64.b64encode(body).decode("ascii"), "name": "Audit_Queue_Application.zip",
                     "actor": specification["operator"], "note": "Independent complete ordered-queue receiving."})
                comparison = original.compare_received(exported_snapshot, installed.snapshot(received),
                    state["workspaceId"], digest(body), members)
                received_queues = [r for r in received.state()["exports"] if r["kind"] == "recipient-queue" and r["sha256"] == queue_record["sha256"]]
                require(received_queues, "queue_received", "The complete original queue is absent in receiving.")
                reopened_queue = received.perform({"action": "recipient.queue.get", "inputs": {"exportId": received_queues[0]["id"]}})["result"]
                require(reopened_queue["readOnly"] and reopened_queue["queue"] == queue["queue"]
                        and [r["queue"] for r in reopened_queue["history"]] == [r["queue"] for r in queue["history"]],
                        "queue_received", "The original received queue or ancestry differs.")
                following = original.native(received, root, "queue-reexport-application", "export.create",
                    {"kind": "application", "actor": specification["operator"], "note": "Complete received queue and original native custody."})
                following_record, following_bytes = received.download(following["id"])
                recipient.publish(root / "Audit_Queue_Received_Application.zip", following_bytes)
                reopened = Workspace(root / "received-workspace")
                try:
                    require(reopened.state() == received.state(), "queue_reopen", "The full received workspace did not reopen exactly.")
                finally:
                    reopened.close()
            finally:
                received.close()
            result = {"schema": "commons.audit-recipient-queue-native-result.v1", "operation": OPERATION,
                "input": selected, "browser": browser, "queue": queue, "queuePackage": package_record,
                "application": record, "received": outcome, "comparison": comparison,
                "receivedApplication": following_record, "native": "complete", "renderedRecipientReady": False}
        finally:
            author.close()
        print(canonical(original.complete_archive(root, result)), flush=True)
        return 0

if __name__ == "__main__":

"""Continue one existing Audit case through offline recipient authoring and native receiving."""

import argparse
import base64
import copy
import fcntl
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import signal
import stat
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import time
from datetime import datetime

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(HERE))
from common import AuditError, canonical, digest, require
from workspace import Workspace
import audit_recipient_review as recipient

OPERATION = "AUDIT-RECIPIENT-REVIEW-24EA-20261013"
_INTERRUPTED = None
_DRAINING = False

class ReceivingInterrupted(KeyboardInterrupt): pass

def interrupted(number, _frame):
    global _INTERRUPTED
    if _INTERRUPTED is None:
        _INTERRUPTED = number
        if not _DRAINING:
            raise ReceivingInterrupted("The original receiving was interrupted by signal " + str(number))


def data(value): return (canonical(value) + "\n").encode()
def read_json(path): return recipient.checked_json(recipient.read_file(path, recipient.MAX_PACKAGE), recipient.MAX_PACKAGE)
def put(path, value): recipient.publish(path, data(value))
def identity(path):
    path = Path(path)
    require(path.is_file() and not path.is_symlink(), "receiving_file", "Retain an ordinary complete file.")
    with path.open("rb") as stream:
        before = os.fstat(stream.fileno()); h = hashlib.sha256(); size = 0
        for chunk in iter(lambda: stream.read(4 * 1024 * 1024), b""): h.update(chunk); size += len(chunk)
        after = os.fstat(stream.fileno())
    require((before.st_dev, before.st_ino, before.st_size, before.st_mtime_ns)
            == (after.st_dev, after.st_ino, after.st_size, after.st_mtime_ns) and size == before.st_size,
            "receiving_file", "A selected file changed during its complete read.")
    return {"bytes": size, "sha256": h.hexdigest()}

def native(workspace, root, label, action, inputs):
    path = root / "native-requests" / (label + ".json")
    if path.exists():
        request = read_json(path)
        require(request["action"] == action and request["inputs"] == inputs,
                "receiving_request", "Retain the complete original native request.")
    else:
        import uuid
        request = {"requestId": str(uuid.uuid4()), "expectedVersion": workspace.state()["version"],
                   "action": action, "inputs": inputs}
        put(path, request)
    result_path = root / "native-results" / (label + ".json")
    if result_path.exists():
        # A retained success cannot be turned into a fresh request after store loss.
        workspace.perform({"action": "operation.get", "inputs": {"requestId": request["requestId"]}})
    outcome = workspace.perform(request)
    result = {"request": request, "result": outcome["result"]}
    put(result_path, result)
    return outcome["result"]

def process_identity(pid):
    try:
        raw = Path("/proc") / str(pid) / "stat"
        fields = raw.read_text().rsplit(")", 1)[1].split()
        return {"pid": pid, "parent": int(fields[1]), "start": fields[19], "state": fields[0]}
    except (OSError, ValueError, IndexError): return None

def collect_children(known):
    rows = []
    for entry in Path("/proc").iterdir():
        if entry.name.isdigit():
            row = process_identity(int(entry.name))
            if row: rows.append(row)
    changed = True
    while changed:
        changed = False
        for row in rows:
            if row["parent"] in known and row["pid"] not in known:
                parent = process_identity(row["parent"])
                if parent and parent["start"] == known[row["parent"]]["start"]:
                    known[row["pid"]] = row; changed = True
    return [row for pid, prior in known.items()
            if (row := process_identity(pid)) and row["start"] == prior["start"] and row["state"] != "Z"]

def signal_owned(rows, number):
    for row in rows:
        current = process_identity(row["pid"])
        if current and current["start"] == row["start"] and current["state"] != "Z":
            try: os.kill(row["pid"], number)
            except ProcessLookupError: pass

def drain_owned(child, known):
    # Playwright may put Chromium in another process group. Track the actual
    # descendant PID/start identity as well as the original Node parent.
    deadline = time.monotonic() + 20
    first = True
    while True:
        live = collect_children(known)
        if not live: break
        if first or time.monotonic() >= deadline:
            signal_owned(live, signal.SIGTERM if first else signal.SIGKILL)
            first = False
        try: child.wait(timeout=0.2)
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired: pass
        time.sleep(0.05)
    child.wait()

def owned_child(command, cwd, log, lock_fd):
    """Release the inherited lease only after every observed owned child exits."""
    global _DRAINING
    with log.open("ab", buffering=0) as output:
        child = None; known = {}
        previous_mask = signal.pthread_sigmask(signal.SIG_BLOCK, {signal.SIGTERM, signal.SIGINT})
        try:
            # Popen inherits the temporary blocked mask; reset it in this exact
            # child before exec, preserving its PID, process group and lease FD.
            wrapper = "import os,signal,sys;signal.pthread_sigmask(signal.SIG_SETMASK,{int(x) for x in sys.argv[1].split(',') if x});os.execvpe(sys.argv[2],sys.argv[2:],os.environ)"
            launched = [sys.executable, "-c", wrapper, ",".join(str(int(x)) for x in previous_mask), *command]
            child = subprocess.Popen(launched, cwd=cwd, stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, stdout=output,
                                     stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, pass_fds=tuple(lock_fd) if isinstance(lock_fd, (tuple, list)) else (lock_fd,), start_new_session=True)
            row = process_identity(child.pid)
            require(row is not None, "receiving_process", "The original child identity did not return.")
            known[child.pid] = row
            signal.pthread_sigmask(signal.SIG_SETMASK, previous_mask)
            print(canonical({"stage": "recipient-browser-started", "pid": child.pid}), flush=True)
            while True:
                collect_children(known)
                try: code = child.wait(timeout=0.2); break
                except subprocess.TimeoutExpired: pass
        finally:
            # A latched parent handler cannot interrupt this drain a second time.
            _DRAINING = True
            try:
                if child is not None: drain_owned(child, known)
                signal.pthread_sigmask(signal.SIG_SETMASK, previous_mask)
            finally: _DRAINING = False
        if _INTERRUPTED is not None:
            raise ReceivingInterrupted("The original receiving was interrupted after its owned children drained.")
        require(code == 0, "receiving_browser", "Continue the same saved browser course and log.",
                {"returncode": code, "log": str(log)}, 409)

def validate_plan(plan, original):
    require(isinstance(plan, dict) and set(plan) == {"schema", "reviews"}
            and plan["schema"] == "commons.audit-recipient-receiving-plan.v1"
            and isinstance(plan["reviews"], list) and 1 <= len(plan["reviews"]) <= 1000,
            "receiving_plan", "Supply explicit complete recipient proposals.")
    _, _, kinds, _ = recipient.package(original)
    import uuid
    expected = recipient.FIELDS - {"localId", "baseReviewSha256", "sourceSha256"}
    seen = set()
    for row in plan["reviews"]:
        require(isinstance(row, dict) and set(row) == expected, "receiving_plan",
                "Every proposal keeps all native review fields, including blank id for a new review.")
        require(not row["id"] or row["id"] not in seen, "receiving_plan", "Select each existing native review once.")
        seen.add(row["id"])
        rev = kinds.get("revision", {}).get(row["revisionId"])
        require(rev is not None, "receiving_plan", "Select a retained original revision.")
        prior = kinds.get("review", {}).get(row["id"])
        full = {**copy.deepcopy(row), "localId": str(uuid.uuid4()), "sourceSha256": rev["sha256"],
                "baseReviewSha256": digest(canonical(prior).encode()) if prior else ""}
        recipient.validate_review(full, kinds)

def compare_received(original_snapshot, received_snapshot, author_id, package_sha, original_members):
    originals = {(r["kind"], r["id"]): r["payload"] for r in original_snapshot["records"]}
    received = {(r["kind"], r["payload"].get("receivedFrom", {}).get("recordId")): r["payload"]
                for r in received_snapshot["records"]
                if r["payload"].get("receivedFrom", {}).get("workspaceId") == author_id
                and r["payload"].get("receivedFrom", {}).get("packageSha256") == package_sha}
    require(set(originals) == set(received), "receiving_records", "The native receiving omitted an original record.")
    id_map = {old["id"]: received[key]["id"] for key, old in originals.items()}
    export_map = {row["receivedFrom"]["exportId"]: row for row in received_snapshot["priorExports"]
                  if row.get("receivedFrom", {}).get("workspaceId") == author_id
                  and row["receivedFrom"].get("packageSha256") == package_sha}
    preserved = {"original", "receivedFrom", "receivedHistory", "derivedHistory", "receivedValidation",
                 "nativeIdentity", "selection", "selectionSummary"}
    def remapped(value, field=None):
        # Compare the unchanged original receiver's documented identity projection.
        if field in preserved: return copy.deepcopy(value)
        if isinstance(value, list): return [remapped(item, field) for item in value]
        if isinstance(value, dict): return {key: remapped(item, key) for key, item in value.items()}
        if isinstance(value, str):
            if field in {"id", "sourceId", "revisionId", "parentId", "currentRevisionId", "editionId", "analysisId", "projectionId", "exportId"}:
                return id_map.get(value, export_map.get(value, {}).get("id", value))
            if field == "downloadUrl" and value.startswith("/api/download/"):
                return export_map.get(value[len("/api/download/"):], {}).get("downloadUrl", value)
        return value
    for key, old in originals.items():
        new = received[key]
        require(new["id"] != old["id"], "receiving_identity", "Independent receiving requires its original remapped identities.")
        rebuilt = copy.deepcopy(old)
        if key[0] == "revision":
            from model import validate_document
            source = originals[("source", old["sourceId"])]
            obj = next(row for row in original_snapshot["objects"] if row["sha256"] == old["sha256"])
            model, validation = validate_document(original_members[obj["path"]], source["nativeIdentity"],
                                                  old.get("selectedSchema"), old.get("profileIds"))
            history = new.get("derivedHistory", [])
            prefix = old.get("derivedHistory", [])
            require(len(history) == len(prefix) + 1 and history[:-1] == prefix,
                    "receiving_history", "Original native validation history was lost.")
            addition = history[-1]
            require(addition == {"workspaceId": author_id, "revisionId": old["id"],
                    "packageSha256": package_sha, "receivedAt": addition.get("receivedAt"),
                    "model": old["model"], "validation": old["validation"], "declaredVersion": old.get("declaredVersion")},
                    "receiving_history", "The original revalidation receipt lost its full predecessor.")
            timestamps = [addition["receivedAt"], new["validation"]["startedAt"], new["validation"]["endedAt"]]
            require(all(isinstance(value, str) and value.endswith("Z") for value in timestamps),
                    "receiving_timestamp", "The original revalidation times are incomplete.")
            parsed = [datetime.fromisoformat(value.replace("Z", "+00:00")) for value in timestamps]
            require(parsed[1] <= parsed[2] <= parsed[0], "receiving_timestamp", "Original revalidation time order differs.")
            # Native timestamp values are observational; every computed field is
            # still compared to the unchanged original validation engine.
            validation["startedAt"], validation["endedAt"] = timestamps[1], timestamps[2]
            rebuilt.update({"model": model, "validation": validation,
                            "declaredVersion": model["declaredVersion"], "derivedHistory": history})
        expected = remapped(rebuilt)
        previous = copy.deepcopy(old.get("receivedHistory", []))
        if old.get("receivedFrom"): previous.append(copy.deepcopy(old["receivedFrom"]))
        if previous: expected["receivedHistory"] = previous
        expected["receivedFrom"] = new["receivedFrom"]
        if key[0] == "analysis" and old["status"] in {"queued", "running"}:
            expected["status"] = "received-" + old["status"]
        require(new == expected, "receiving_record", "The complete native received record differs beyond its original identity projection.",
                {"kind": key[0], "recordId": key[1]})
    source_objects = {(r["sha256"], r["bytes"]) for r in original_snapshot["objects"]}
    received_objects = {(r["sha256"], r["bytes"]) for r in received_snapshot["objects"]}
    require(source_objects <= received_objects, "receiving_objects", "Full native receiving omitted original source/output bytes.")
    original_ops = {o["id"]: o for o in original_snapshot["operations"]}
    received_ops = {r["payload"]["original"]["id"]: r["payload"]["original"]
                    for r in received_snapshot["records"] if r["kind"] == "received-operation"
                    and r["payload"].get("originWorkspaceId") == author_id
                    and r["payload"].get("packageSha256") == package_sha}
    require(received_ops == original_ops, "receiving_operations", "The receiving lost original accepted request history.")
    return {"records": len(originals), "objects": len(source_objects), "operations": len(original_ops)}

def complete_archive(root, result):
    put(root / "RUN_RESULT.json", result)
    paths = []
    for path in sorted(root.rglob("*")):
        relative = path.relative_to(root).as_posix()
        if not path.is_file() or path.is_symlink() or path.name.endswith(".lock") or "/profile/" in "/" + relative:
            continue
        if relative in {"ARCHIVE_INDEX.json", "COMPLETE.json"} or path.name.startswith("."):
            continue
        paths.append((relative, path))
    index = {"schema": "commons.audit-recipient-complete-archive.v1", "operation": OPERATION,
             "members": [{"path": name, **identity(path)} for name, path in paths],
             "exclusions": ["Live lock files and reproducible browser profile; complete downloaded working copies, manuscript, original bytes and native receiving are included."]}
    put(root / "ARCHIVE_INDEX.json", index)
    paths.append(("ARCHIVE_INDEX.json", root / "ARCHIVE_INDEX.json"))
    output = root.parent / ("Audit_Recipient_Operated_" + digest(data(result["input"]))[:16] + ".zip")
    fd, pending = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix=".audit-recipient-", dir=root.parent)
    try:
        with os.fdopen(fd, "w+b") as stream:
            with zipfile.ZipFile(stream, "w", compression=zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED, allowZip64=True) as archive:
                for name, path in paths:
                    info = zipfile.ZipInfo(name, (1980, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0))
                    info.create_system = 3; info.external_attr = (stat.S_IFREG | 0o600) << 16
                    info.compress_type = zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED
                    with archive.open(info, "w", force_zip64=True) as out, path.open("rb") as source:
                        for chunk in iter(lambda: source.read(4 * 1024 * 1024), b""): out.write(chunk)
            stream.flush(); os.fsync(stream.fileno())
        with zipfile.ZipFile(pending) as archive:
            require(set(archive.namelist()) == {name for name, _ in paths}, "receiving_archive", "The full archive inventory changed.")
            for name, path in paths:
                h = hashlib.sha256(); size = 0
                with archive.open(name) as source:
                    for chunk in iter(lambda: source.read(4 * 1024 * 1024), b""): h.update(chunk); size += len(chunk)
                require({"bytes": size, "sha256": h.hexdigest()} == identity(path), "receiving_archive", "An archived complete member differs.")
        try: os.link(pending, output)
        except FileExistsError:
            require(identity(output) == identity(pending), "receiving_archive", "Preserve a differing earlier whole archive.")
    finally:
        os.unlink(pending)
    receipt = {"schema": "commons.audit-recipient-complete.v1", "operation": OPERATION,
               "input": result["input"], "archive": {"path": str(output), **identity(output)},
               "renderedRecipientReady": False,
               "remaining": "Producing operator must open and inspect the captured desktop/narrow images and every outgoing recipient attachment, then repair any concrete issue before claiming ready."}
    put(root / "COMPLETE.json", receipt)
    return receipt

def main(argv=None):
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    for name in ("workspace", "archive", "archive-sha256", "review-plan", "directory", "operator", "chromium", "playwright-module"):
        parser.add_argument("--" + name, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--node", default="node")
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    root = Path(args.directory).expanduser().resolve()
    require(root != HERE and HERE not in root.parents, "receiving_directory", "Keep this original receiving outside installed source.")
    root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True, mode=0o700)
    with (root / "operation.lock").open("a+b") as lock:
        fcntl.flock(lock, fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
        original = recipient.read_file(args.archive, recipient.MAX_PACKAGE)
        require(digest(original) == args.archive_sha256, "receiving_input", "The selected original export differs.")
        plan_raw = recipient.read_file(args.review_plan, recipient.MAX_DRAFT)
        plan = recipient.checked_json(plan_raw); validate_plan(plan, original)
        _, snapshot, _, _ = recipient.package(original)
        directory = Path(args.workspace).expanduser().resolve()
        require((directory / "audit-exchange.sqlite").is_file(), "receiving_workspace", "Use the existing original author workspace.")
        require(directory != root and root not in directory.parents and directory not in root.parents,
                "receiving_directory", "Keep the receiving journal separate from the original native store.")
        declared = read_json(HERE / "SOURCE_FILES.json")["files"]
        require(len(declared) == len(set(declared)), "receiving_source", "The source inventory repeats a member.")
        source_rows = []
        for name in declared:
            relative = Path(name)
            require(not relative.is_absolute() and ".." not in relative.parts, "receiving_source", "Use the original complete source inventory.")
            source_rows.append({"path": name, **identity(HERE / relative)})
        selected = {"operation": OPERATION, "applicationSource": source_rows, "workspace": str(directory), "workspaceId": snapshot["workspace"]["workspaceId"],
                    "originalArchive": {"bytes": len(original), "sha256": digest(original)},
                    "reviewPlan": {"bytes": len(plan_raw), "sha256": digest(plan_raw)},
                    "operator": recipient.string(args.operator, 240, False)}
        put(root / "INPUT.json", selected)
        recipient.publish(root / "original-review.zip", original)
        recipient.publish(root / "REVIEW_PLAN.json", plan_raw)
        if (root / "COMPLETE.json").exists():
            receipt = read_json(root / "COMPLETE.json")
            require(receipt["input"] == selected and identity(receipt["archive"]["path"])
                    == {k: receipt["archive"][k] for k in ("bytes", "sha256")},
                    "receiving_complete", "The retained full receiving result differs.")
            print(canonical(receipt), flush=True); return 0
        if (root / "RUN_RESULT.json").exists():
            result = read_json(root / "RUN_RESULT.json")
            require(result["input"] == selected, "receiving_complete", "The completed native run belongs to another source.")
            # Native and browser work are already closed. Preserve the exact
            # original index/files through a packaging-only continuation.
            receipt = complete_archive(root, result)
            print(canonical({"stage": "recipient-archive-resumed", **receipt}), flush=True)
            return 0
        for name in declared:
            relative = Path(name)
            require(not relative.is_absolute() and ".." not in relative.parts, "receiving_source", "Use the original complete source inventory.")
            recipient.publish(root / "application" / relative, recipient.read_file(HERE / relative, recipient.MAX_PACKAGE))
        author = Workspace(directory)
        try:
            require(author.state()["workspaceId"] == selected["workspaceId"], "receiving_workspace",
                    "The original author workspace identity differs.")
            require(not any(r["status"] in {"running", "queued"} for r in author.state()["analysisRuns"]),
                    "receiving_active", "Continue the recipient course after the existing original analysis owner completes.")
            delivery = root / "recipient"
            receipt = recipient.prepare(root / "original-review.zip", delivery)
            put(root / "PREPARED.json", receipt)
            # Repeat the same prepared publication to demonstrate exact-byte reopen.
            require(recipient.prepare(root / "original-review.zip", delivery) == receipt,
                    "receiving_prepare", "The repeated complete original preparation changed.")

FORMAT = "commons.audit-exchange.commissioning.v1"
INPUT_FORMAT = "commons.audit-exchange.commissioning-input.v1"

    "combined": ("fixture-l100-bsyncr-2.7.0.xml", 71256,
                 "9862c46fce26d90f019dab4ec9c2ccd79f4602cd48e117fb39d7e2103975c7b5"),

}

def canonical(value):
    return json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=True, separators=(",", ":"), sort_keys=True)
def raw_json(value):
    return (canonical(value) + "\n").encode("utf-8")
def sha(raw):
    return hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
def now():
    return time.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ", time.gmtime())
def need(condition, message):
    if not condition:
        raise RuntimeError(message)
def emit(value):
    print(canonical(value), flush=True)
def read_json(path):
    return json.loads(Path(path).read_bytes())
def safe_name(value):
    need(isinstance(value, str) and value and "\\" not in value and "\0" not in value,
         "Use one retained relative member name.")
    p = Path(value)
    need(not p.is_absolute() and all(part not in {"", ".", ".."} for part in p.parts),
         "Keep every source member inside its selected application.")
    return p

def atomic(path, raw, *, replace=False):
    path = Path(path)
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    if path.exists() and not replace:
        need(not path.is_symlink() and path.read_bytes() == raw,
             "A retained original file differs: " + str(path))
        return
    fd, candidate = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix="." + path.name + ".", dir=path.parent)
    try:
        with os.fdopen(fd, "wb") as out:
            out.write(raw)
            out.flush()
            os.fsync(out.fileno())
        if replace:
            os.replace(candidate, path)
        else:
            try:
                os.link(candidate, path, follow_symlinks=False)
            except FileExistsError:
                need(path.read_bytes() == raw, "Another original file differs: " + str(path))
        parent = os.open(path.parent, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_DIRECTORY)
        try:
            os.fsync(parent)
        finally:
            os.close(parent)
    finally:
        Path(candidate).unlink(missing_ok=True)

def package(raw):
    """Read and verify the actual export's complete member inventory."""
    with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(raw)) as archive:
        members = archive.infolist()
        names = [item.filename for item in members]
        need(len(names) == len(set(names)) and "manifest.json" in names,
             "The complete export must contain one original member per name.")
        for item in members:
            safe_name(item.filename)
            need(not item.is_dir() and not stat.S_ISLNK(item.external_attr >> 16),
                 "A workspace export contains ordinary complete members.")
        manifest = json.loads(archive.read("manifest.json"))
        rows = manifest["members"]
        need(len(rows) == len(names) - 1 and {row["path"] for row in rows} == set(names) - {"manifest.json"},
             "The actual export inventory does not cover its full member set.")
        bodies = {}
        for row in rows:
            body = archive.read(row["path"])
            need(len(body) == row["bytes"] and sha(body) == row["sha256"],
                 "The retained export member changed: " + row["path"])
            bodies[row["path"]] = body

    def __init__(self, directory, inputs_path, application, adopt_source=False):

        target = self.root / "source" / digest

        record = {"format": FORMAT, "operation": OPERATION, "sha256": digest, "files": rows}
