NMECR_COMMIT = "343146d7a1e20d027e6ca48bd7ca2b38c646592a"
NMECR_VERSION = "1.0.18"
MODELS = ("Mean", "SLR", "3PC", "3PH", "4P", "5P", "HDD", "CDD", "HDD-CDD", "TOW", "TOWT")
MODEL_ARGUMENTS = {
    "has_temp_knots_defined", "equal_temp_segment_points", "temp_segments_numeric",
    "temp_knots_value", "initial_breakpoints", "occupancy_threshold", "day_normalized",
}
OPTIONS = {
    "models", "sourceTimezone", "weatherTimezone", "weatherColumns", "weatherUnits",
    "weatherInterval", "endPolicy", "lastEnd", "interval", "baseline", "reporting",
    "normalization", "modelArguments", "balancePoint", "confidenceLevel",
    "allowNegativePredictions", "seed", "timeoutSeconds", "weatherMissingValues",
}
ENERGY_UNITS = {
    "Wh", "kWh", "MWh", "GWh", "Btu", "kBtu", "MBtu", "MMBtu", "therms", "Therms",
    "therm", "MJ", "GJ", "kJ", "J", "kcal", "Mcal", "MMcal",
}
INTERVAL_SECONDS = {"15-min": 900, "Hourly": 3600, "Daily": 86400}
UTC = dt.timezone.utc


class AnalysisInputError(ValueError):
    def __init__(self, code, message, details=None):
        super().__init__(message)
        self.code, self.details = code, details or {}


def need(condition, code, message, details=None):
    if not condition:
        raise AnalysisInputError(code, message, details)


def encoded(value):
    return json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"),
                      allow_nan=False).encode("utf-8")


def sha256(body):
    return hashlib.sha256(body).hexdigest()


def fsync_dir(path):
    fd = os.open(path, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_DIRECTORY)
    try:
        os.fsync(fd)
    finally:
        os.close(fd)


def atomic(path, body, *, immutable=False):
    path = Path(path)
    need(path.parent.resolve() == path.parent.absolute(), "analysis_path",
         "Keep the analysis in its original ordinary directory.")
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, mode=0o700, exist_ok=True)
    if path.exists() or path.is_symlink():
        need(not path.is_symlink() and path.is_file(), "analysis_path",
             "A retained analysis name is not an ordinary file.")
        if immutable:
            need(path.read_bytes() == body, "analysis_input_changed",
                 "This analysis directory already contains different original input.",
                 {"name": path.name})
            return
    candidate = path.with_name(path.name + ".pending-" + uuid.uuid4().hex)
    try:
        with candidate.open("xb") as out:
            out.write(body)
            out.flush()
            os.fsync(out.fileno())
        candidate.chmod(0o600)
        if immutable:
            try:
                os.link(candidate, path)
            except FileExistsError:
                need(path.read_bytes() == body, "analysis_input_changed",
                     "The retained original input changed during receiving.")
        else:
            os.replace(candidate, path)
        fsync_dir(path.parent)
    finally:
        candidate.unlink(missing_ok=True)


def json_file(path, value, *, immutable=False):
    atomic(path, encoded(value) + b"\n", immutable=immutable)


def ordinary_file(path):
    path = Path(path)
    need(not path.is_symlink() and path.is_file(), "source_file",
         "The complete original source file is unavailable.")
    return path.read_bytes()


def zone(name, label):
    need(isinstance(name, str) and bool(name), "timezone_required",
         f"Choose the {label} timezone explicitly for timestamps without offsets.")
    try:
        return ZoneInfo(name)
    except ZoneInfoNotFoundError as exc:
        raise AnalysisInputError("timezone_unknown", f"The {label} timezone is not an IANA name.",
                                 {"timezone": name}) from exc


def timestamp(value, timezone_name, label):
    need(isinstance(value, str) and bool(value.strip()), "timestamp_required",
         f"The {label} timestamp is missing.")
    try:
        parsed = dt.datetime.fromisoformat(value.strip().replace("Z", "+00:00"))
    except ValueError as exc:
        raise AnalysisInputError("timestamp_invalid", f"The {label} timestamp is not ISO 8601.",
                                 {"value": value}) from exc
    if parsed.tzinfo is None:
        tz = zone(timezone_name, label)
        first, second = parsed.replace(tzinfo=tz, fold=0), parsed.replace(tzinfo=tz, fold=1)
        need(first.utcoffset() == second.utcoffset(), "timestamp_ambiguous",
             "An ambiguous local timestamp needs its original UTC offset.",
             {"label": label, "value": value, "timezone": timezone_name})
        need(first.astimezone(UTC).astimezone(tz).replace(tzinfo=None) == parsed,
             "timestamp_nonexistent", "A local timestamp falls in a clock change gap.",
             {"label": label, "value": value})
        parsed = first
    return parsed


def number(value, label):
    need(not isinstance(value, bool), "number_invalid", f"The {label} value is not a number.")
    try:
        exact = decimal.Decimal(str(value))
        result = float(exact)
    except (decimal.InvalidOperation, OverflowError, ValueError) as exc:
        raise AnalysisInputError("number_invalid", f"The {label} value is not numeric.",
                                 {"value": str(value)}) from exc
    need(exact.is_finite() and math.isfinite(result), "number_nonfinite",
         f"The {label} value must be finite.", {"value": str(value)})
    return result


def next_period(start, interval):
    if interval == "Monthly":
        year, month = (start.year + 1, 1) if start.month == 12 else (start.year, start.month + 1)
        try:
            return start.replace(year=year, month=month)
        except ValueError as exc:
            raise AnalysisInputError("interval_end_required",
                                     "This monthly reading needs its original end timestamp.") from exc
    if interval == "Daily":
        return start + dt.timedelta(days=1)
    need(interval in INTERVAL_SECONDS, "interval_unknown",
         "Choose 15-min, Hourly, Daily, or Monthly.")
    return start + dt.timedelta(seconds=INTERVAL_SECONDS[interval])


def infer_interval(rows, requested=None):
    if requested is not None:
        need(requested in (*INTERVAL_SECONDS, "Monthly"), "interval_unknown",
             "Choose 15-min, Hourly, Daily, or Monthly.")
        interval = requested
    else:
        durations = [b.timestamp() - a.timestamp() for a, b, _, _ in rows]
        if all(28 * 86400 <= value <= 32 * 86400 for value in durations):
            interval = "Monthly"
        else:
            matching = [key for key, seconds in INTERVAL_SECONDS.items()
                        if all(abs(value - seconds) < 0.001 for value in durations)]
            need(len(matching) == 1, "interval_required",
                 "Choose a supported interval matching the original readings.")
            interval = matching[0]
    for start, end, _, source in rows:
        expected = next_period(start, interval)
        if interval == "Monthly":
            # Native monthly billing intervals can differ in length, but must
            # begin/end on whole local days and keep their original boundaries.
            need(start.time() == dt.time() and end.time() == dt.time()
                 and 28 * 86400 - 3600 <= end.timestamp() - start.timestamp() <= 35 * 86400 + 3600,
                 "monthly_boundary", "Monthly energy needs whole-day original billing intervals.",
                 {"reading": source.get("key")})
        else:
            need(abs(expected.timestamp() - end.timestamp()) < 0.001, "interval_mismatch",
                 "The requested model interval differs from an original reading.",
                 {"reading": source.get("key"), "interval": interval})
    return interval


def selected_readings(selection, options):
    reading_type = selection.get("readingType")
    need(reading_type == "Total", "non_energy_selection",
         "Choose a Total energy stream for energy modeling.",
         {"readingType": reading_type, "units": selection.get("units"),
          "supportedPurpose": "energy consumption"})
    units = selection.get("units")
    need(isinstance(units, str) and bool(units), "units_required",
         "The selected energy stream needs its original units.")
    # Volume-based fuel inputs may be useful but need an explicit, retained
    # calorific-value conversion first. Never present their totals as energy.
    need(units in ENERGY_UNITS, "energy_units_required",
         "This stream needs energy units before it can enter the energy model.",
         {"units": units})
    building, scenario, resource = (selection.get(key) or {} for key in ("building", "scenario", "resource"))
    for label, value in (("building", building), ("scenario", scenario), ("resource", resource)):
        need(bool(value.get("key")), "selection_required", f"Select one original {label}.")
    need(resource.get("resourceUnits") in (None, "", units), "resource_units_mismatch",
         "The selected units differ from the resource's original energy units.")
    raw = selection.get("readings")
    need(isinstance(raw, list) and len(raw) >= 3, "readings_required",
         "Select at least three complete original energy readings.")
    starts = [timestamp(row.get("start"), options.get("sourceTimezone"), "meter")
              for row in raw]
    rows, keys = [], set()
    for index, (source, start) in enumerate(zip(raw, starts)):
        need(isinstance(source, dict), "reading_shape", "Each selected reading must be an object.")
        key = source.get("key") or source.get("path")
        need(bool(key) and key not in keys, "reading_duplicate",
             "Each original reading must appear exactly once.")
        keys.add(key)
        need(source.get("readingType") == "Total" and source.get("units") == units,
             "mixed_quantity", "The selection contains different quantities or units.",
             {"reading": key})
        quantity = source.get("quantity")
        need(quantity not in ("Cost", "Peak", "Demand"), "non_energy_selection",
             "The reading quantity is not total energy.", {"reading": key, "quantity": quantity})
        need(source.get("resourceKey") == resource["key"], "mixed_resource",
             "The selection contains a different resource.", {"reading": key})
        need(source.get("scenarioKey") == scenario["key"], "mixed_scenario",
             "The selection contains a different scenario.", {"reading": key})
        linked_buildings = source.get("buildingKeys") or []
        need(not linked_buildings or linked_buildings == [building["key"]],
             "building_ambiguous", "The stream has conflicting or multiple original building associations.",
             {"reading": key, "buildingKeys": linked_buildings})
        end_literal = source.get("end")
        if end_literal:
            end = timestamp(end_literal, options.get("sourceTimezone"), "meter end")
        else:
            policy = options.get("endPolicy", "required")
            if policy == "next-reading" and index + 1 < len(raw):
                end = starts[index + 1]
            elif policy == "frequency":
                end = next_period(start, options.get("interval"))
            elif policy == "next-reading" and options.get("lastEnd"):
                end = timestamp(options["lastEnd"], options.get("sourceTimezone"), "final meter end")
            else:
                raise AnalysisInputError("interval_end_required",
                                         "Retain the original end timestamp or choose an explicit end policy.",
                                         {"reading": key})
        need(end.timestamp() > start.timestamp(), "interval_invalid",
             "Each original interval must end after it starts.", {"reading": key})
        value = number(source.get("value"), "energy reading")
        rows.append((start, end, value, source))
    for before, after in zip(rows, rows[1:]):
        need(before[0].timestamp() < after[0].timestamp(), "reading_order",
             "Retain readings in strictly increasing source time order.")
        need(abs(before[1].timestamp() - after[0].timestamp()) < 0.001, "meter_gap_or_overlap",
             "Energy intervals must be contiguous and non-overlapping.",
             {"before": before[3].get("key"), "after": after[3].get("key")})
    interval = infer_interval(rows, options.get("interval"))
    # nmecr's intervals are inferred from UTC elapsed time. Its daily algorithms
    # require a fixed 1,440-minute median. Original local clock shifts remain in
    # the retained inputs; nonuniform hourly/monthly boundaries are verified later.
    return rows, interval


def weather_rows(body, options, meter_rows, interval):
    need(bool(body), "weather_required", "Attach the complete observed weather CSV.")
    try:
        text = body.decode("utf-8-sig")
        reader = csv.DictReader(io.StringIO(text, newline=""))
        original_rows = list(reader)
    except (UnicodeError, csv.Error) as exc:
        raise AnalysisInputError("weather_csv", "The weather input is not a UTF-8 CSV.") from exc
    need(bool(original_rows), "weather_empty", "The weather CSV has no readings.")
    columns = {"time": "time", "temp": "temp", **(options.get("weatherColumns") or {})}
    need(all(isinstance(k, str) and isinstance(v, str) for k, v in columns.items())
         and set(columns) <= {"time", "temp", "end", "station"},
         "weather_columns", "Use time, temp, optional end, and optional station column mappings.")
    need(all(value in (reader.fieldnames or []) for value in columns.values()),
         "weather_columns", "A selected weather column is missing.", {"columns": columns})
    units = options.get("weatherUnits")
    need(units in ("F", "C", "degF", "degC", "°F", "°C"), "weather_units_required",
         "Choose the original weather temperature units explicitly.")
    weather_interval = options.get("weatherInterval")
    need(weather_interval in ("15-min", "Hourly", "Daily"), "weather_interval_required",
         "Choose the original observed weather interval: 15-min, Hourly, or Daily.")
    need(interval == "Monthly" or INTERVAL_SECONDS[weather_interval] <= INTERVAL_SECONDS[interval],
         "weather_too_coarse", "Weather must be at least as frequent as the selected meter interval.")
    missing = {str(value).strip() for value in options.get("weatherMissingValues", ["", "NA", "NaN", "9999.9"])}
    rows, stations = [], set()
    for index, source in enumerate(original_rows, 2):
        literal = (source.get(columns["temp"]) or "").strip()
        need(literal not in missing, "weather_missing",
             "A weather row is missing its observed temperature.", {"csvLine": index})
        start = timestamp(source.get(columns["time"]), options.get("weatherTimezone"), "weather")
        end = (timestamp(source.get(columns["end"]), options.get("weatherTimezone"), "weather end")
               if "end" in columns else next_period(start, weather_interval))
        need(end.timestamp() > start.timestamp(), "weather_interval_invalid",
             "Each observed weather interval needs a positive duration.", {"csvLine": index})
        need(abs(next_period(start, weather_interval).timestamp() - end.timestamp()) < 0.001,
             "weather_interval_mismatch", "The weather end differs from its declared interval.",
             {"csvLine": index})
        value = number(literal, "weather temperature")
        fahrenheit = value * 9 / 5 + 32 if units in ("C", "degC", "°C") else value
        station = source.get(columns.get("station", ""), "")
        if station:
            stations.add(station)
        rows.append((start, end, fahrenheit, index, literal))
    need(len(stations) <= 1, "weather_station_mixed",
         "Select one observed weather station for this model.", {"stations": sorted(stations)})
    for before, after in zip(rows, rows[1:]):
        need(before[0].timestamp() < after[0].timestamp(), "weather_order",
             "Keep observed weather in strictly increasing timestamp order.")
        need(before[1].timestamp() <= after[0].timestamp() + 0.001, "weather_overlap",
             "Observed weather intervals overlap.")
    first, last = meter_rows[0][0].timestamp(), meter_rows[-1][1].timestamp()
    chosen = [row for row in rows if row[1].timestamp() > first and row[0].timestamp() < last]
    need(bool(chosen) and abs(chosen[0][0].timestamp() - first) < 0.001
         and abs(chosen[-1][1].timestamp() - last) < 0.001,
         "weather_coverage", "Observed weather must cover every complete selected energy interval.",
         {"meterStart": meter_rows[0][0].isoformat(), "meterEnd": meter_rows[-1][1].isoformat()})
    for before, after in zip(chosen, chosen[1:]):
        need(abs(before[1].timestamp() - after[0].timestamp()) < 0.001, "weather_gap",
             "Observed weather is missing an interval within the model period.",
             {"beforeCsvLine": before[3], "afterCsvLine": after[3]})
    return rows, chosen, {"originalRows": len(original_rows), "selectedRows": len(chosen),
                          "units": units, "nativeUnits": "F", "interval": weather_interval,
                          "stations": sorted(stations), "columns": columns}


def window(value, rows, tz_name, label):
    if value is None:
        return None
    need(isinstance(value, dict) and set(value) == {"start", "end"}, "period_shape",
         f"Choose both original boundaries for the {label} period.")
    start = timestamp(value["start"], tz_name, label).timestamp()
    end = timestamp(value["end"], tz_name, label).timestamp()
    chosen = [i for i, row in enumerate(rows)
              if row[0].timestamp() >= start and row[1].timestamp() <= end]
    need(len(chosen) >= 3 and rows[chosen[0]][0].timestamp() == start
         and rows[chosen[-1]][1].timestamp() == end, "period_boundary",
         f"The {label} period must contain at least three whole original readings.")
    return {"start": start, "end": end, "indices": [index + 1 for index in chosen],
            "original": value}


def csv_bytes(header, rows):
    stream = io.StringIO(newline="")
    writer = csv.writer(stream, lineterminator="\n")
    writer.writerow(header)
    writer.writerows(rows)
    return stream.getvalue().encode("utf-8")


def outputs_in(root):
    outputs = []
    for path in sorted(root.rglob("*")):
        if not path.is_file() or path.is_symlink():
            continue
        relative = path.relative_to(root).as_posix()
        if relative in ("result.json", "operation.lock") or ".pending-" in relative:
            continue
        body = path.read_bytes()
        media = ({".rds": "application/x-r-rds", ".R": "text/plain", ".log": "text/plain",
                  ".csv": "text/csv", ".json": "application/json"}.get(path.suffix)
                 or mimetypes.guess_type(path.name)[0] or "application/octet-stream")
        outputs.append({"name": relative, "path": str(path), "mime": media,
                        "bytes": len(body), "sha256": sha256(body)})
    return outputs


def valid_saved_result(path, digest, root):
    if not path.exists():
        return None
    result = json.loads(ordinary_file(path))
    need(result.get("metadata", {}).get("inputSha256") == digest,
         "analysis_input_changed", "The retained analysis belongs to different original input.")
    if not result.get("metadata", {}).get("terminal"):
        return None
    for entry in result.get("outputs", []):
        target = root / entry["name"]
        need(target.resolve().is_relative_to(root) and not target.is_symlink(),
             "analysis_output_path", "A retained analysis output escaped its original directory.")
        body = ordinary_file(target)
        need(len(body) == entry["bytes"] and sha256(body) == entry["sha256"],
             "analysis_output_changed", "A retained complete analysis output differs.",
             {"name": entry["name"]})
        entry["path"] = str(target)
    return result


def _run(selection, weather_bytes, weather_metadata, model_options, root, lease_fd):
    options = dict(model_options or {})
    need(isinstance(selection, dict) and isinstance(weather_metadata, dict), "analysis_shape",
         "Supply the original selection and weather metadata.")
    unknown = sorted(set(options) - OPTIONS)
    need(not unknown, "model_options_unknown", "The model options contain unsupported fields.",
         {"fields": unknown})
    script = Path(__file__).with_name("native_analysis.R")
    script_body = ordinary_file(script)
    wrapper_body = ordinary_file(Path(__file__))
    original = ordinary_file(selection.get("sourceXmlPath", ""))
    need(sha256(original) == selection.get("sourceSha256"), "source_hash",
         "The selected original XML differs from its saved source hash.")
    need(isinstance(weather_bytes, bytes), "weather_bytes", "Pass the complete original weather bytes.")
    need(weather_metadata.get("sha256") in (None, sha256(weather_bytes))
         and weather_metadata.get("bytes") in (None, len(weather_bytes)),
         "weather_hash", "The weather bytes differ from the saved original metadata.")
    source_selection = {key: value for key, value in selection.items() if key != "sourceXmlPath"}
    identity = {"schema": SCHEMA, "selection": source_selection, "weather": weather_metadata,
                "weatherSha256": sha256(weather_bytes), "modelOptions": options,
                "nativeScriptSha256": sha256(script_body), "wrapperSha256": sha256(wrapper_body)}
    digest = sha256(encoded(identity))
    saved = valid_saved_result(root / "result.json", digest, root)
    if saved is not None:
        return saved
    json_file(root / "input.json", identity, immutable=True)
    json_file(root / "selection.json", source_selection, immutable=True)
    atomic(root / "original.xml", original, immutable=True)
    atomic(root / "weather.csv", weather_bytes, immutable=True)
    json_file(root / "weather-metadata.json", weather_metadata, immutable=True)
    atomic(root / "native_analysis.R", script_body, immutable=True)
    metadata = {"schema": SCHEMA, "inputSha256": digest, "selectionSha256": selection.get("selectionSha256"),
                "sourceSha256": sha256(original), "weatherSha256": sha256(weather_bytes),
                "nmecrExpected": {"version": NMECR_VERSION, "sourceCommit": NMECR_COMMIT},
                "nativeScriptSha256": sha256(script_body), "startedAt": dt.datetime.now(UTC).isoformat(),
                "terminal": False}
    diagnostics = []
    native = None
    status = "failed"
    try:
        rows, interval = selected_readings(selection, options)
        unassigned = [row[3].get("key") for row in rows if not row[3].get("buildingKeys")]
        metadata["buildingScope"] = {
            "buildingKey": selection["building"]["key"],
            "assignment": "operator-selected" if unassigned else "original-source-linked",
            "originalUnassignedReadingKeys": unassigned,
        }
        if unassigned:
            diagnostics.append({"code": "operator_building_scope",
                "message": "The selected building is an explicit operator choice for originally unassigned readings.",
                "details": {"buildingKey": selection["building"]["key"], "unassignedReadings": len(unassigned)}})
        all_weather, chosen_weather, weather_info = weather_rows(weather_bytes, options, rows, interval)
        models = options.get("models", list(MODELS))
        need(isinstance(models, list) and bool(models) and len(models) == len(set(models))
             and all(model in MODELS for model in models), "models_invalid",
             "Choose named models from the complete native model catalog.")
        arguments = options.get("modelArguments", {})
        need(isinstance(arguments, dict) and set(arguments) <= MODEL_ARGUMENTS,
             "model_arguments", "Use the documented native model arguments.")
        baseline = window(options.get("baseline"), rows, options.get("sourceTimezone"), "baseline")
        reporting = window(options.get("reporting"), rows, options.get("sourceTimezone"), "reporting")
        need(not reporting or bool(baseline), "baseline_required",
             "Choose a baseline period before requesting reporting-period savings.")
        need(not reporting or not (set(reporting["indices"]) & set(baseline["indices"])),
             "period_overlap", "Baseline and reporting periods must use different original readings.")
        normalization = options.get("normalization")
        if normalization is not None:
            need(bool(reporting) and isinstance(normalization, dict)
                 and set(normalization) == {"start", "end"}, "normalization_period",
                 "Normalized savings needs explicit baseline, reporting, and weather periods.")
            ns = timestamp(normalization["start"], options.get("weatherTimezone"), "normalization").timestamp()
            ne = timestamp(normalization["end"], options.get("weatherTimezone"), "normalization").timestamp()
            weather_window = [row for row in all_weather
                              if row[0].timestamp() >= ns and row[1].timestamp() <= ne]
            need(bool(weather_window) and weather_window[0][0].timestamp() == ns
                 and weather_window[-1][1].timestamp() == ne, "normalization_weather",
                 "The original observed weather must cover the entire normalization period.")
            for left, right in zip(weather_window, weather_window[1:]):
                need(left[1].timestamp() == right[0].timestamp(), "normalization_weather_gap",
                     "The normalization weather has a missing interval.")
            normalization = {"start": ns, "end": ne, "original": normalization}
        model_tz = options.get("sourceTimezone")
        if not model_tz:
            first_offset = rows[0][0].utcoffset()
            need(first_offset == dt.timedelta(0) and all(row[0].utcoffset() == first_offset for row in rows),
                 "source_timezone_required",
                 "Choose the building's IANA timezone for modeling time-of-week.")
            model_tz = "UTC"
        zone(model_tz, "model")
        atomic(root / "meter-native.csv", csv_bytes(
            ["time", "end", "eload", "readingKey", "originalStart", "originalEnd", "originalValue"],
            [[row[0].timestamp(), row[1].timestamp(), format(row[2], ".17g"),
              row[3].get("key"), row[3].get("start"), row[3].get("end"), row[3].get("value")] for row in rows]),
               immutable=True)
        atomic(root / "weather-native.csv", csv_bytes(
            ["time", "end", "temp", "csvLine", "originalValue"],
            [[row[0].timestamp(), row[1].timestamp(), format(row[2], ".17g"), row[3], row[4]]
             for row in all_weather]), immutable=True)
        request = {"schema": SCHEMA, "inputSha256": digest, "directory": str(root),
                   "timezone": model_tz, "interval": interval, "models": models,
                   "arguments": arguments, "balancePoint": number(options.get("balancePoint", 65), "balance point"),
                   "confidenceLevel": number(options.get("confidenceLevel", 90), "confidence level"),
                   "allowNegativePredictions": bool(options.get("allowNegativePredictions", False)),
                   "seed": options.get("seed", 20261012), "baseline": baseline, "reporting": reporting,
                   "normalization": normalization, "units": selection["units"],
                   "expectedRows": len(rows), "weather": weather_info,
                   "source": {"id": selection.get("sourceId"), "revisionId": selection.get("revisionId"),
                              "building": selection["building"], "scenario": selection["scenario"],
                              "resource": selection["resource"], "readingType": selection["readingType"]}}
        need(0 < request["confidenceLevel"] < 100, "confidence_level",
             "The confidence level must be between zero and 100.")
        need(isinstance(request["seed"], int) and 0 <= request["seed"] <= 2147483647,
             "seed_invalid", "Use an integer random seed from zero through 2147483647.")
        timeout = number(options.get("timeoutSeconds", 3600), "timeout")
        need(30 <= timeout <= 86400, "timeout_invalid", "Choose an execution timeout of 30 to 86400 seconds.")
        json_file(root / "native-request.json", request, immutable=True)
        rscript = os.environ.get("AUDIT_RSCRIPT", "Rscript")
        command = [rscript, "--vanilla", str(root / "native_analysis.R"), str(root / "native-request.json")]
        json_file(root / "invocation.json", {"argv": command, "inputSha256": digest,
                  "startedAt": metadata["startedAt"], "timeoutSeconds": timeout,
                  "leaseInherited": lease_fd is not None})
        with (root / "native-stdout.log").open("ab", buffering=0) as stdout, \
             (root / "native-stderr.log").open("ab", buffering=0) as stderr:
            process = subprocess.Popen(command, cwd=root, stdout=stdout, stderr=stderr,
                                       pass_fds=(lease_fd,), start_new_session=True,
                                       env=dict(os.environ, TZ=model_tz))
            metadata["pid"] = process.pid
            try:
                returncode = process.wait(timeout=timeout)
            except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                os.killpg(process.pid, signal.SIGTERM)
                try:
                    process.wait(timeout=10)
                except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                    os.killpg(process.pid, signal.SIGKILL)
                    process.wait()
                raise AnalysisInputError("native_timeout",
                                         "The native model run reached its execution timeout; completed models are retained.")
        metadata["nativeExit"] = returncode
        json_file(root / "native-exit.json", {"exitCode": returncode, "inputSha256": digest,
                  "at": dt.datetime.now(UTC).isoformat()})
        native_path = root / "native-result.json"
        if native_path.exists():
            native = json.loads(ordinary_file(native_path))
            need(native.get("inputSha256") == digest, "native_result_identity",
                 "The native result belongs to different original input.")
            diagnostics.extend(native.get("diagnostics") or [])
            status = native.get("status", "failed")
            metadata["native"] = native.get("metadata", {})
            metadata["models"] = native.get("models", [])
            metadata["terminal"] = bool(native.get("terminal")) and returncode == 0
        else:
            diagnostics.append({"code": "native_exit", "message": "The native process returned before its final result.",
                                "details": {"exitCode": returncode}})
        metadata["inputRows"] = len(rows)
        metadata["interval"] = interval
        metadata["weather"] = weather_info
    except AnalysisInputError as exc:
        status = "needs-input" if exc.code not in ("native_timeout", "native_result_identity") else "failed"
        diagnostics.append({"code": exc.code, "message": str(exc), "details": exc.details})
        metadata["terminal"] = exc.code not in ("native_timeout", "native_result_identity")
    except FileNotFoundError as exc:
        status = "needs-runtime"
        diagnostics.append({"code": "runtime_unavailable",
                            "message": "Install the pinned native analysis runtime on this host.",
                            "details": {"filename": exc.filename}})
    except Exception as exc:
        diagnostics.append({"code": "analysis_error", "message": str(exc),
                            "details": {"type": type(exc).__name__}})
        atomic(root / "python-error.log", traceback.format_exc().encode("utf-8"))
    metadata["finishedAt"] = dt.datetime.now(UTC).isoformat()
    metadata["resumable"] = not metadata["terminal"] and status in ("needs-runtime", "failed")
    result = {"status": status, "outputs": outputs_in(root), "diagnostics": diagnostics,
              "metadata": metadata}
    json_file(root / "result.json", result)
    return result


def run_analysis(selection, weather_bytes, weather_metadata, model_options, workdir, *, lease_fd=None):
    """Run or resume one complete native analysis in its original owned directory.

    A supplied lease remains held by every native descendant. The caller owns its
    lifetime. Direct callers receive an equivalent nonblocking local directory
    lease and a useful busy result if another native invocation still holds it.
    """
    root = Path(workdir).expanduser().absolute()
    need(root.resolve() == root, "analysis_path", "Use an ordinary absolute analysis directory.")
    root.mkdir(mode=0o700, parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    root.chmod(0o700)
    if lease_fd is not None:
        os.fstat(lease_fd)
        return _run(selection, weather_bytes, weather_metadata, model_options, root, lease_fd)
    lock_path = root / "operation.lock"
    need(not lock_path.is_symlink(), "analysis_path", "The analysis lease must be an ordinary file.")
    with lock_path.open("a+b") as lock:
        try:
            fcntl.flock(lock, fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
        except BlockingIOError:
            return {"status": "running", "outputs": [], "diagnostics": [],
                    "metadata": {"schema": SCHEMA, "directory": str(root), "leaseHeld": True}}
        return _run(selection, weather_bytes, weather_metadata, model_options, root, lock.fileno())

"""Audit Exchange local application server and complete native command interface."""
from __future__ import annotations
import argparse
import ipaddress
import json
import mimetypes
import signal
import sys
import threading
import traceback
import uuid
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer
from pathlib import Path
from urllib.parse import quote, urlsplit

from common import AuditError, canonical, require
from exchange import APPLICATION_ROOT
from workspace import Workspace

STARTUP_SCHEMA = "commons.audit-exchange.startup.v1"
MAX_REQUEST_BYTES = 1431658000
_asset_manifest = json.loads((APPLICATION_ROOT / "browser-assets.json").read_text("utf-8"))
require(_asset_manifest.get("schema") == "stellar-forge.browser-assets.v1" and _asset_manifest.get("root") == "./",
        "application_assets", "The original application route manifest differs")
STATIC = {}
for _route, (_file, _mime) in _asset_manifest["routes"]:
    require(_route.startswith("/") and _route not in STATIC and not Path(_file).is_absolute()
            and ".." not in Path(_file).parts, "application_assets", "The original browser route is invalid")
    STATIC[_route] = (_file, _mime)

def error_response(error, workspace=None):
    known = isinstance(error, AuditError)
    result = {"ok": False, "error": {
        "code": error.code if known else "application_error",
        "message": str(error) if known else "The native application could not complete this request; inspect its server log."}}
    if known and error.details is not None:
        result["error"]["details"] = error.details
    if workspace:
        try:
            result["stateVersion"] = workspace.state()["version"]
        except Exception:
            pass
    return result, error.status if known else 500

def parse_json(raw):
    try:
        result = json.loads(raw)
    except (ValueError, UnicodeError) as error:
        raise AuditError("invalid_json", "The complete request must contain valid JSON") from error
    require(isinstance(result, dict), "invalid_request", "The complete native request must be a JSON object")
    return result

def check_identity(workspace, expected):
    identity = workspace.state()["workspaceId"]
    if expected is not None:
        require(expected == identity, "workspace_identity", "The selected original workspace identity differs",
                {"workspaceId": identity}, 409)
    return identity

class AuditServer(ThreadingHTTPServer):
    daemon_threads = True
    allow_reuse_address = False

    def __init__(self, address, workspace):
        self.workspace = workspace
        self.identity = workspace.state()
        self.instance_id = str(uuid.uuid4())
        super().__init__(address, AuditHandler)
        self.url = "http://127.0.0.1:" + str(self.server_port) + "/"
        self.startup = {
            "schema": STARTUP_SCHEMA, "url": self.url, "workspaceId": self.identity["workspaceId"],
            "workspaceCreatedAt": self.identity["createdAt"], "instanceId": self.instance_id,
            "directory": str(workspace.directory)}

class AuditHandler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    protocol_version = "HTTP/1.1"
    server_version = "AuditExchange/1.0"
    sys_version = ""

    def setup(self):
        super().setup()
        self.connection.settimeout(60)

    @property
    def workspace(self):
        return self.server.workspace

    def log_message(self, format, *args):
        sys.stderr.write("%s %s\n" % (self.log_date_time_string(), format % args))

    def _same_origin(self):
        expected = "127.0.0.1:" + str(self.server.server_port)
        require(self.headers.get("Host") == expected, "local_host",
                "Use the exact local application address announced by the server", status=403)
        origin = self.headers.get("Origin")
        require(origin is None or origin == "http://" + expected, "local_origin",
                "An application request must originate from its own local workspace", status=403)
        require(self.headers.get("Sec-Fetch-Site") not in {"cross-site"},
                "local_origin", "Open the original local application address", status=403)

    def _identity(self):
        value = self.headers.get("X-Audit-Workspace-Id")
        require(value == self.server.identity["workspaceId"], "workspace_identity",
                "The request must name this original workspace identity",
                {"workspaceId": self.server.identity["workspaceId"]}, 409)
        instance = self.headers.get("X-Audit-Instance-Id")
        require(instance is None or instance == self.server.instance_id, "instance_changed",
                "The original application instance changed; inspect and deliberately reconnect", status=409)

    def _respond(self, status, raw, mime, additional=None, head=False):
        self.send_response(status)
        self.send_header("Content-Type", mime)
        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(raw)))
        self.send_header("Cache-Control", "no-store")
        self.send_header("X-Content-Type-Options", "nosniff")
        self.send_header("Referrer-Policy", "no-referrer")
        self.send_header("Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy", "same-origin")
        self.send_header("Content-Security-Policy", "default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'; form-action 'self'")
        for name, value in (additional or {}).items():
            self.send_header(name, value)
        self.end_headers()
        if not head:
            self.wfile.write(raw)

    def _json(self, status, value, head=False):
        self._respond(status, (canonical(value) + "\n").encode("utf-8"), "application/json; charset=utf-8", head=head)

    def _failure(self, error):
        self.close_connection = True
        if not isinstance(error, AuditError):
            traceback.print_exc(file=sys.stderr)
        value, status = error_response(error, self.workspace)
        try:
            self._json(status, value)
        except (BrokenPipeError, ConnectionResetError):
            pass

    def do_HEAD(self):
        self.do_GET(head=True)

    def do_GET(self, head=False):
        try:
            self._same_origin()
            parsed = urlsplit(self.path)
            require(not parsed.scheme and not parsed.netloc and not parsed.query and not parsed.fragment,
                    "request_path", "Use the original application route", status=404)
            path = parsed.path
            if path == "/api/state":
                self._json(200, {"ok": True, "result": self.workspace.state()}, head)
            elif path == "/api/identity":
                self._identity()
                self._json(200, self.server.startup, head)
            elif path.startswith("/api/download/"):
                self._identity()
                identity = path[len("/api/download/"):]
                require(identity and "/" not in identity and "%" not in identity, "download_id", "Select one complete export", status=404)
                record, raw = self.workspace.download(identity)
                mime = record.get("mime") or mimetypes.guess_type(record["name"])[0] or "application/octet-stream"
                require("\r" not in mime and "\n" not in mime, "download_mime", "The retained download media type is invalid")
                self._respond(200, raw, mime, {
                    "Content-Disposition": "attachment; filename*=UTF-8''" + quote(record["name"], safe=""),
                    "ETag": '"' + record["sha256"] + '"',
                    "X-Audit-SHA256": record["sha256"],
                    "X-Audit-Workspace-Id": self.server.identity["workspaceId"]}, head)
            elif path in STATIC:
                relative, mime = STATIC[path]
                target = APPLICATION_ROOT / relative
                require(target.is_file() and not target.is_symlink(), "application_file", "This original application file is absent", status=404)
                self._respond(200, target.read_bytes(), mime, head=head)
            else:
                raise AuditError("not_found", "This application route does not exist", status=404)
        except Exception as error:
            self._failure(error)

    def do_POST(self):
        try:
            self._same_origin()
            self._identity()
            require(self.path == "/api/action", "not_found", "This native action route does not exist", status=404)
            require(self.headers.get("Content-Type", "").split(";", 1)[0].strip().lower() == "application/json",
                    "request_media_type", "A native action uses application/json", status=415)
            require(self.headers.get("Transfer-Encoding") is None, "request_length", "Supply the complete request length")
            lengths = self.headers.get_all("Content-Length") or []
            require(len(lengths) == 1 and lengths[0].isdigit(), "request_length", "Supply one complete request length")
            count = int(lengths[0])
            require(0 < count <= MAX_REQUEST_BYTES, "input_too_large", "The complete request exceeds the local application's configured capacity", status=413)
            raw = self.rfile.read(count)
            require(len(raw) == count, "incomplete_request", "The original action body did not arrive completely")
            self._json(200, self.workspace.perform(parse_json(raw)))
        except Exception as error:
            self._failure(error)

    def do_OPTIONS(self):
        self._failure(AuditError("local_origin", "Use this application from its original local address", status=403))

def serve(workspace, port=8769, expected_id=None):
    check_identity(workspace, expected_id)
    server = AuditServer(("127.0.0.1", port), workspace)
    workspace.start_worker()
    def stop(*unused):
        threading.Thread(target=server.shutdown, daemon=True).start()
    for number in (signal.SIGINT, signal.SIGTERM):
        signal.signal(number, stop)
    print(canonical(server.startup), flush=True)
    try:
        server.serve_forever(poll_interval=0.3)
    finally:
        server.server_close()
        workspace.close()

def main(argv=None):
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Retain, review, analyse and exchange complete native building audits.")
    commands = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True)
    for name in ("init", "state", "action", "serve", "analysis-work"):
        sub = commands.add_parser(name)
        sub.add_argument("--directory", required=True, help="Original local working project directory")
        sub.add_argument("--workspace-id", help="Pin the original saved workspace identity")
        if name == "init":
            sub.add_argument("--name", default="Audit Exchange workspace")
        if name == "action":
            sub.add_argument("--request-json", default="-", help="Complete action envelope filename, or - for stdin")
        if name == "serve":
            sub.add_argument("--host", choices=["127.0.0.1"], default="127.0.0.1")
            sub.add_argument("--port", type=int, default=8769)
        if name == "analysis-work":
            sub.add_argument("--analysis-id", help="Run this original queued operation; otherwise process the current queue")
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    workspace = None
    try:
        workspace = Workspace(args.directory, getattr(args, "name", "Audit Exchange workspace"))
        check_identity(workspace, args.workspace_id)
        if args.command == "serve":
            require(0 <= args.port <= 65535, "port", "Select a valid local listener port")
            serve(workspace, args.port, args.workspace_id)
            return 0
        if args.command in {"init", "state"}:
            result = {"ok": True, "result": workspace.state()}
        elif args.command == "action":
            if args.request_json == "-":
                raw = sys.stdin.buffer.read(MAX_REQUEST_BYTES + 1)
            else:
                source = Path(args.request_json)
                require(source.is_file() and source.stat().st_size <= MAX_REQUEST_BYTES, "request_file", "Select the complete original request file")
                raw = source.read_bytes()
            require(len(raw) <= MAX_REQUEST_BYTES, "input_too_large", "The complete action exceeds the configured input capacity")
            result = workspace.perform(parse_json(raw))
        else:
            identities = [args.analysis_id] if args.analysis_id else [
                row["id"] for row in workspace.state()["analysisRuns"] if row["status"] in {"queued", "running"}]
            processed = [{"analysisId": identity, "processed": workspace.run_analysis_job(identity)} for identity in identities]
            result = {"ok": True, "result": processed, "state": workspace.state()}
        print(canonical(result), flush=True)
        return 0
    except Exception as error:
        value, status = error_response(error, workspace)
        print(canonical(value), flush=True)
        if not isinstance(error, AuditError):
            traceback.print_exc(file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
    finally:
        if workspace:
            workspace.close()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

"""Offline Audit recipient reviews, accepted by the original Workspace.perform API."""
from __future__ import annotations
import argparse
import base64
import copy
import fcntl
import hashlib
import io
import json
import os
import stat
import tempfile
import uuid
import zipfile
from contextlib import contextmanager
from pathlib import Path
from urllib.parse import urlparse
from common import AuditError, canonical, digest, require, now
from exchange import unpack_package, APPLICATION_ROOT

DRAFT = "commons.audit-recipient-manuscript.v1"
INPUT = "commons.audit-recipient-input.v1"
PREVIEW = "commons.audit-recipient-preview.v1"
MAX_DRAFT = 32 * 1024 * 1024
MAX_PACKAGE = 1024 * 1024 * 1024
FIELDS = {"localId", "id", "baseReviewSha256", "sourceId", "revisionId", "sourceSha256",
          "entityKey", "title", "status", "assignee", "dueDate", "actor", "note", "evidence"}
ASSETS = ("audit-recipient.html", "audit-recipient.js", "audit-recipient.css", "local-file-hash.js")

def encoded(value):
    return (canonical(value) + "\n").encode("utf-8")

def exact_keys(value, keys):
    require(isinstance(value, dict) and set(value) == set(keys), "recipient_shape",
            "Retain every original recipient field, without extra fields.")

def string(value, maximum, blank=True):
    require(isinstance(value, str) and len(value) <= maximum and (blank or bool(value.strip()))
            and not any(ord(c) < 32 and c not in "\n\r\t" for c in value),
            "recipient_text", "Complete the bounded recipient text.")
    try:
        value.encode("utf-8")
    except UnicodeError as error:
        raise AuditError("recipient_text", "Use complete Unicode characters.") from error
    return value

def checked_json(raw, maximum=MAX_DRAFT):
    require(isinstance(raw, bytes) and len(raw) <= maximum, "recipient_capacity",
            "The complete recipient document exceeds its declared capacity.")
    def pairs(rows):
        value = {}
        for key, item in rows:
            require(key not in value, "recipient_json", "Repeated JSON keys are not accepted.")
            value[key] = item
        return value
    try:
        return json.loads(raw, object_pairs_hook=pairs,
                          parse_constant=lambda _: (_ for _ in ()).throw(ValueError("finite JSON required")))
    except (ValueError, UnicodeError, RecursionError) as error:
        raise AuditError("recipient_json", "Use one complete finite UTF-8 JSON document.") from error

def read_file(path, maximum):
    path = Path(path)
    require(path.is_file() and not path.is_symlink(), "recipient_file", "Select an ordinary complete file.")
    with path.open("rb") as stream:
        before = os.fstat(stream.fileno())
        require(stat.S_ISREG(before.st_mode) and before.st_size <= maximum,
                "recipient_capacity", "The selected complete file exceeds its capacity.")
        raw = stream.read(maximum + 1)
        after = os.fstat(stream.fileno())
    require(len(raw) == before.st_size and (before.st_dev, before.st_ino, before.st_size, before.st_mtime_ns)
            == (after.st_dev, after.st_ino, after.st_size, after.st_mtime_ns),
            "recipient_file", "The selected file changed while being read.")
    return raw

def publish(path, raw):
    path = Path(path); path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    fd, pending = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix="." + path.name + "-", dir=path.parent)
    try:
        with os.fdopen(fd, "wb") as stream:
            stream.write(raw); stream.flush(); os.fsync(stream.fileno())
        try:
            os.link(pending, path)
        except FileExistsError:
            require(read_file(path, max(len(raw), 1)) == raw, "recipient_existing",
                    "This retained output already names different complete bytes.", {"path": str(path)}, 409)
        directory = os.open(path.parent, os.O_RDONLY)
        try: os.fsync(directory)
        finally: os.close(directory)
    finally:
        os.unlink(pending)

@contextmanager
def held(directory):
    directory = Path(directory); directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    lock = directory / "recipient.lock"
    require(not lock.is_symlink(), "recipient_lock", "Use the original ordinary recipient lock.")
    with lock.open("a+b") as stream:
        fcntl.flock(stream, fcntl.LOCK_EX)
        yield

def package(raw):
    manifest, members = unpack_package(raw)
    require(manifest.get("kind") in {"workspace", "application"} and "workspace.json" in members,
            "recipient_package", "Select the complete original Audit workspace or application ZIP.")
    snapshot = checked_json(members["workspace.json"], MAX_PACKAGE)
    require(snapshot.get("format") == "commons.audit-exchange.snapshot.v1"
            and isinstance(snapshot.get("workspace"), dict) and isinstance(snapshot.get("records"), list),
            "recipient_package", "The original native workspace snapshot is absent.")
    by_kind = {}
    for record in snapshot["records"]:
        require(isinstance(record, dict) and isinstance(record.get("payload"), dict)
                and record.get("id") == record["payload"].get("id"), "recipient_record",
                "An original native record identity is invalid.")
        group = by_kind.setdefault(record.get("kind"), {})
        require(record["id"] not in group, "recipient_record", "An original record identity is repeated.")
        group[record["id"]] = record["payload"]
    workspace = snapshot["workspace"]
    require(isinstance(workspace.get("workspaceId"), str) and type(workspace.get("version")) is int,
            "recipient_workspace", "Retain the exact original native workspace identity.")
    objects = {row["sha256"]: row for row in snapshot["objects"]}
    for revision in by_kind.get("revision", {}).values():
        require(revision["sourceId"] in by_kind.get("source", {}), "recipient_source",
                "A retained source revision has no original source.")
        obj = objects.get(revision["sha256"])
        require(obj is not None and obj["path"] in members
                and digest(members[obj["path"]]) == revision["sha256"]
                and len(members[obj["path"]]) == revision["bytes"],
                "recipient_source", "A complete original source revision is absent.")
    return manifest, snapshot, by_kind, members

def original_identity(raw, snapshot):
    return {"archiveSha256": digest(raw), "archiveBytes": len(raw),
            "workspaceId": snapshot["workspace"]["workspaceId"],
            "workspaceVersion": snapshot["workspace"]["version"],
            "selectedEditionId": snapshot.get("selectedEditionId")}

def prepare_input(raw):
    manifest, snapshot, kinds, members = package(raw)
    objects = {row["sha256"]: row for row in snapshot["objects"]}
    sources = []
    for source in kinds.get("source", {}).values():
        revisions = []
        for revision in sorted((r for r in kinds.get("revision", {}).values()
                                if r["sourceId"] == source["id"]), key=lambda r: r["number"]):
            model = revision["model"]; body = members[objects[revision["sha256"]]["path"]]
            revisions.append({"id": revision["id"], "number": revision["number"],
                "sha256": revision["sha256"], "bytes": revision["bytes"],
                "entities": [{"key": e["key"], "label": e.get("label", e["key"]),
                              "kind": e.get("semanticKind") or e.get("kind", ""), "path": e.get("path", "")}
                             for e in model["entities"]],
                "fields": model["fields"], "validation": revision["validation"],
                "xml": body.decode(model.get("encoding") or "utf-8", errors="replace")})
        sources.append({"id": source["id"], "name": source["name"],
                        "currentRevisionId": source["currentRevisionId"], "revisions": revisions})
    return {"schema": INPUT, "source": original_identity(raw, snapshot), "sources": sources,
            "reviews": list(kinds.get("review", {}).values()),
            "editions": list(kinds.get("edition", {}).values()), "manifest": manifest}

def prepare(archive, output):
    raw = read_file(archive, MAX_PACKAGE); document = prepare_input(raw)
    output = Path(output).resolve(); body = encoded(document)
    require(len(body) <= 128 * 1024 * 1024, "recipient_capacity",
            "This complete offline source projection exceeds 128 MiB; use the native Audit application.")
    publish(output / "original-review.zip", raw)
    template = (APPLICATION_ROOT / "public" / ASSETS[0]).read_text("utf-8")
    html = template.replace("<!--AUDIT_RECIPIENT_INPUT-->",
        '<script type="application/octet-stream" id="recipient-input" data-sha256="' + digest(body) + '">' +
        base64.b64encode(body).decode("ascii") + "</script>")
    publish(output / "Audit_Recipient_Review.html", html.encode("utf-8"))
    for name in ASSETS[1:]:
        publish(output / name, (APPLICATION_ROOT / "public" / name).read_bytes())
    publish(output / "RECIPIENT_INPUT.json", body)
    receipt = {"schema": "commons.audit-recipient-delivery.v1", "source": document["source"],
               "inputSha256": digest(body), "files": [{"path": p.name, "bytes": p.stat().st_size,
                       "sha256": digest(read_file(p, MAX_PACKAGE))}
                       for p in [output / name for name in ("original-review.zip", "Audit_Recipient_Review.html", *ASSETS[1:], "RECIPIENT_INPUT.json")]]}
    publish(output / "RECIPIENT_DELIVERY.json", encoded(receipt))
    complete = io.BytesIO()
    with zipfile.ZipFile(complete, "w", compression=zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED, allowZip64=True) as zipped:
        for item in receipt["files"]:
            zip_member(zipped, item["path"], read_file(output / item["path"], MAX_PACKAGE), zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED)
        zip_member(zipped, "RECIPIENT_DELIVERY.json", encoded(receipt), zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED)
    publish(output / "Audit_Recipient_Complete.zip", complete.getvalue())
    return receipt

def zip_member(archive, name, raw, compression=zipfile.ZIP_STORED):
    info = zipfile.ZipInfo(name, date_time=(1980, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0))
    info.create_system = 3
    info.external_attr = (stat.S_IFREG | 0o600) << 16
    info.compress_type = compression
    archive.writestr(info, raw)

def validate_review(row, kinds):
    exact_keys(row, FIELDS)
    try: uuid.UUID(row["localId"])
    except (ValueError, TypeError, AttributeError) as error:
        raise AuditError("recipient_id", "Retain the original manuscript review UUID.") from error
    string(row["id"], 160); string(row["baseReviewSha256"], 64)
    revision = kinds.get("revision", {}).get(row["revisionId"])
    require(revision and revision["sourceId"] == row["sourceId"]
            and revision["sha256"] == row["sourceSha256"], "recipient_source",
            "The review must select one exact original source revision.")
    require(not row["entityKey"] or any(e["key"] == row["entityKey"] for e in revision["model"]["entities"]),
            "recipient_entity", "The review selected an entity outside its original revision.")
    if row["id"]:
        prior = kinds.get("review", {}).get(row["id"])
        require(prior and prior["sourceId"] == row["sourceId"]
                and row["baseReviewSha256"] == digest(canonical(prior).encode()),
                "recipient_review", "The existing review must retain its complete original head identity.")
    else:
        require(row["baseReviewSha256"] == "", "recipient_review", "A new review has no existing native head.")
    for name, maximum, blank in (("title", 500, False), ("actor", 240, False), ("assignee", 500, True),
                                  ("dueDate", 100, True), ("note", 32000, True)):
        string(row[name], maximum, blank)
    require(row["status"] in {"open", "investigating", "resolved", "accepted"},
            "recipient_status", "Select an original native review status.")
    require(isinstance(row["evidence"], list) and len(row["evidence"]) <= 100,
            "recipient_evidence", "Retain at most 100 complete evidence references.")
    for item in row["evidence"]:
        exact_keys(item, {"label", "url"}); string(item["label"], 500, False); string(item["url"], 4000, False)
        require(urlparse(item["url"]).scheme in {"http", "https"} and bool(urlparse(item["url"]).netloc),
                "recipient_evidence", "Evidence links must be complete HTTP or HTTPS references.")

def validate_draft(raw, original):
    value = checked_json(raw); _, snapshot, kinds, _ = package(original)
    exact_keys(value, {"schema", "manuscriptId", "source", "editions"})
    require(value["schema"] == DRAFT and value["source"] == original_identity(original, snapshot),
            "recipient_source", "The manuscript must retain this exact whole original archive.")
    try: uuid.UUID(value["manuscriptId"])
    except (ValueError, TypeError, AttributeError) as error:
        raise AuditError("recipient_id", "Retain the original manuscript UUID.") from error
    require(isinstance(value["editions"], list) and 1 <= len(value["editions"]) <= 1000,
            "recipient_editions", "Retain all authored editions and at least one complete saved edition.")
    previous = None
    for index, edition in enumerate(value["editions"]):
        exact_keys(edition, {"revision", "previousSha256", "createdAt", "reviews", "sha256"})
        plain = {key: item for key, item in edition.items() if key != "sha256"}
        require(type(edition["revision"]) is int and edition["revision"] == index + 1
                and edition["previousSha256"] == previous and edition["sha256"] == digest(canonical(plain).encode()),
                "recipient_history", "A complete authored edition or its predecessor changed.")
        string(edition["createdAt"], 100, False)
        require(isinstance(edition["reviews"], list) and 1 <= len(edition["reviews"]) <= 1000,
                "recipient_reviews", "Each authored edition contains 1..1000 complete reviews.")
        ids = set(); native_ids = set()
        for row in edition["reviews"]:
            validate_review(row, kinds)
            require(row["localId"] not in ids and (not row["id"] or row["id"] not in native_ids),
                    "recipient_duplicate", "An authored edition repeats a logical or native review.")
            ids.add(row["localId"]); native_ids.add(row["id"])
        previous = edition["sha256"]
    return value, kinds

def make_return(archive, draft, output):
    original = read_file(archive, MAX_PACKAGE); raw = read_file(draft, MAX_DRAFT)
    value, _ = validate_draft(raw, original)
    members = {"original-review.zip": original, "AUDIT_RECIPIENT_MANUSCRIPT.json": raw}
    manifest = {"schema": "commons.audit-recipient-return.v1", "source": value["source"],
                "manuscriptId": value["manuscriptId"], "editionSha256": value["editions"][-1]["sha256"],
                "files": {name: {"bytes": len(body), "sha256": digest(body)} for name, body in members.items()}}
    stream = io.BytesIO()
    with zipfile.ZipFile(stream, "w", compression=zipfile.ZIP_STORED, allowZip64=True) as zipped:
        for name, body in members.items(): zip_member(zipped, name, body)
        zip_member(zipped, "manifest.json", encoded(manifest))
    publish(output, stream.getvalue()); return manifest

def read_return(path):
    raw = read_file(path, MAX_PACKAGE + MAX_DRAFT + 1024 * 1024)
    with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(raw)) as zipped:
        infos = zipped.infolist()
        require(len(infos) == 3 and {i.filename for i in infos}
                == {"original-review.zip", "AUDIT_RECIPIENT_MANUSCRIPT.json", "manifest.json"}
                and all(not i.is_dir() and not stat.S_ISLNK(i.external_attr >> 16) and not i.flag_bits & 1 for i in infos)
                and sum(i.file_size for i in infos) <= MAX_PACKAGE + MAX_DRAFT + 1024 * 1024,
                "recipient_return", "Retain the complete three-member recipient return.")
        original = zipped.read("original-review.zip"); draft = zipped.read("AUDIT_RECIPIENT_MANUSCRIPT.json")
        manifest = checked_json(zipped.read("manifest.json"), 1024 * 1024)
    value, kinds = validate_draft(draft, original)
    expected = {"schema": "commons.audit-recipient-return.v1", "source": value["source"],
                "manuscriptId": value["manuscriptId"], "editionSha256": value["editions"][-1]["sha256"],
                "files": {"original-review.zip": {"bytes": len(original), "sha256": digest(original)},
                          "AUDIT_RECIPIENT_MANUSCRIPT.json": {"bytes": len(draft), "sha256": digest(draft)}}}
    require(manifest == expected, "recipient_return", "The full return manifest differs from its original bodies.")
    return raw, original, draft, value, kinds

def native_inputs(row):
    result = {key: copy.deepcopy(row[key]) for key in
              ("sourceId", "revisionId", "entityKey", "title", "status", "assignee",
               "dueDate", "actor", "note", "evidence")}
    if row["id"]: result["id"] = row["id"]
    return result

def scope(raw, value):
    return {"returnSha256": digest(raw), "manuscriptId": value["manuscriptId"],
            "editionSha256": value["editions"][-1]["sha256"],
            "workspaceId": value["source"]["workspaceId"]}

def request_id(value, local_id, expected):
    return str(uuid.uuid5(uuid.UUID(value["manuscriptId"]),
               value["editions"][-1]["sha256"] + ":" + local_id + ":" + str(expected)))

def discover(workspace, root, selected, value):
    """Recover only original saved requests, validating accepted bodies by native replay."""
    result = {}
    rows = {row["localId"]: row for row in value["editions"][-1]["reviews"]}
    if root is None or not root.exists(): return result
    anchor = root / "SOURCE.json"
    require(anchor.is_file() and checked_json(read_file(anchor, MAX_DRAFT)) == selected,
            "recipient_journal", "This journal belongs to another complete recipient return.")
    for path in sorted((root / "requests").glob("*.json")):
        saved = checked_json(read_file(path, MAX_DRAFT))
        exact_keys(saved, {"source", "localId", "request"})
        row = rows.get(saved["localId"]); request = saved["request"]
        require(saved["source"] == selected and row is not None and isinstance(request, dict),
                "recipient_journal", "A retained request belongs to another manuscript.")
        exact_keys(request, {"requestId", "expectedVersion", "action", "inputs"})
        require(type(request["expectedVersion"]) is int and request["expectedVersion"] >= 0
                and request["requestId"] == request_id(value, row["localId"], request["expectedVersion"])
                and path.name == request["requestId"] + ".json"
                and request["action"] == "review.save" and request["inputs"] == native_inputs(row),
                "recipient_journal", "A retained original native request changed.")
        receipt_path = root / "results" / path.name
        try:
            workspace.perform({"action": "operation.get", "inputs": {"requestId": request["requestId"]}})
        except AuditError as error:
            if error.code != "not_found": raise
            require(not receipt_path.exists(), "recipient_outcome",
                    "A retained successful operation is absent from the original workspace; reconcile its store before another write.")
            continue
        # operation.get establishes existence; unchanged perform verifies the whole body.
        outcome = workspace.perform(request)
        receipt = {"request": request, "result": outcome["result"]}
        publish(receipt_path, encoded(receipt))
        require(row["localId"] not in result or result[row["localId"]]["request"] == request,
                "recipient_duplicate", "More than one accepted native request names this authored review.")
        result[row["localId"]] = {"request": request, "result": outcome["result"]}
    return result

def plan(workspace, return_path, operator, journal=None):
    string(operator, 240, False)
    raw, original, draft, value, kinds = read_return(return_path)
    selected = scope(raw, value)
    require(workspace.state()["workspaceId"] == selected["workspaceId"], "recipient_workspace",
            "Accept this return only in its original author workspace.", status=409)
    root = Path(journal).resolve() if journal else None
    if root is not None:
        with held(root):
            publish(root / "SOURCE.json", encoded(selected))
            accepted = discover(workspace, root, selected, value)
    else: accepted = {}
    state = workspace.state()
    current = {r["id"]: r for r in state["reviews"]}; commands = []; expected = state["version"]
    for row in value["editions"][-1]["reviews"]:
        detail = workspace.perform({"action": "source.get", "inputs": {
            "sourceId": row["sourceId"], "revisionId": row["revisionId"]}})["result"]
        require(detail["revision"]["sha256"] == row["sourceSha256"], "recipient_source",
                "The selected original native source differs.", status=409)
        if row["localId"] in accepted:
            prior = accepted[row["localId"]]
            commands.append({"localId": row["localId"], "accepted": True,
                             "request": prior["request"], "result": prior["result"]})
            continue
        if row["id"]:
            require(row["id"] in current and digest(canonical(current[row["id"]]).encode()) == row["baseReviewSha256"],
                    "recipient_review_changed", "An original review has changed; preserve this return and review the current head.",
                    {"reviewId": row["id"]}, 409)
        request = {"requestId": request_id(value, row["localId"], expected),
                   "expectedVersion": expected, "action": "review.save", "inputs": native_inputs(row)}
        commands.append({"localId": row["localId"], "accepted": False, "request": request, "result": None})
        expected += 1
    result = {"schema": PREVIEW, "workspaceId": state["workspaceId"], "expectedVersion": state["version"],
              "operator": operator, "returnSha256": digest(raw), "returnBytes": len(raw),
              "manuscriptId": value["manuscriptId"], "editionSha256": value["editions"][-1]["sha256"],
              "draftSha256": digest(draft), "originalSource": value["source"], "reviews": commands}
    result["sha256"] = digest(canonical(result).encode()); return result

def validate_preview(workspace, raw, draft, manuscript, preview, accepted):
    """Validate complete original preview without publishing or applying a new request."""
    require(isinstance(preview, dict), "recipient_preview", "Retain the complete preview object.")
    plain = {key: item for key, item in preview.items() if key != "sha256"}
    require(preview.get("schema") == PREVIEW and preview.get("sha256") == digest(canonical(plain).encode())
            and preview.get("returnSha256") == digest(raw), "recipient_preview",
            "Select the complete unchanged preview for this exact returned archive.")
    selected = scope(raw, manuscript)
    require(workspace.state()["workspaceId"] == selected["workspaceId"], "recipient_workspace",
            "This return belongs to another original workspace.")
    # Derive and verify the complete authored bodies independently of preview JSON.
    rows = manuscript["editions"][-1]["reviews"]
    require(len(preview.get("reviews", [])) == len(rows)
            and preview["workspaceId"] == selected["workspaceId"]
            and preview["manuscriptId"] == selected["manuscriptId"]
            and preview["editionSha256"] == selected["editionSha256"]
            and preview["draftSha256"] == digest(draft) and preview["originalSource"] == manuscript["source"],
            "recipient_preview", "The preview does not contain this whole manuscript edition.")
    pending_expected = preview["expectedVersion"]
    require(type(pending_expected) is int and pending_expected >= 0, "recipient_preview", "Retain the native expected version.")
    for row, proposed in zip(rows, preview["reviews"]):
        exact_keys(proposed, {"localId", "accepted", "request", "result"})
        request = proposed["request"]
        require(proposed["localId"] == row["localId"] and type(proposed["accepted"]) is bool
                and isinstance(request, dict) and request.get("inputs") == native_inputs(row),
                "recipient_preview", "A preview changed the complete authored review body.")
        exact_keys(request, {"requestId", "expectedVersion", "action", "inputs"})
        require(request["action"] == "review.save" and type(request["expectedVersion"]) is int
                and request["requestId"] == request_id(manuscript, row["localId"], request["expectedVersion"]),
                "recipient_preview", "The preview changed an original native request identity.")
        if proposed["accepted"]:
            prior = accepted.get(row["localId"])
            require(prior == {"request": request, "result": proposed["result"]},
                    "recipient_outcome", "The preview's accepted original operation is absent or different.")
        else:
            require(request["expectedVersion"] == pending_expected and proposed["result"] is None,
                    "recipient_preview", "The pending native versions are not contiguous.")
            pending_expected += 1
            if row["localId"] in accepted:
                require(accepted[row["localId"]]["request"] == request,
                        "recipient_outcome", "This review has a different accepted original request.")
    # Before any first write validate untouched original review heads against the preview.
    state = workspace.state(); heads = {r["id"]: r for r in state["reviews"]}
    for row in rows:
        if row["localId"] not in accepted and row["id"]:
            require(row["id"] in heads and digest(canonical(heads[row["id"]]).encode()) == row["baseReviewSha256"],
                    "recipient_review_changed", "The existing native review changed after preview.", status=409)
    return selected

def apply(workspace, return_path, preview_path, journal):
    raw, original, draft, manuscript, kinds = read_return(return_path)
    preview = checked_json(read_file(preview_path, MAX_DRAFT))
    plain = {key: item for key, item in preview.items() if key != "sha256"}
    require(preview.get("schema") == PREVIEW and preview.get("sha256") == digest(canonical(plain).encode())
            and preview.get("returnSha256") == digest(raw), "recipient_preview",
            "Select the complete unchanged preview for this exact returned archive.")
    selected = scope(raw, manuscript); root = Path(journal).resolve()
    with held(root):
        require(workspace.state()["workspaceId"] == selected["workspaceId"], "recipient_workspace",
                "This return belongs to another original workspace.")
        publish(root / "SOURCE.json", encoded(selected))
        publish(root / "recipient-return.zip", raw)
        accepted = discover(workspace, root, selected, manuscript)
        validate_preview(workspace, raw, draft, manuscript, preview, accepted)
        publish(root / "previews" / (preview["sha256"] + ".json"), encoded(preview))
        for proposed in preview["reviews"]:
            request = proposed["request"]
            publish(root / "requests" / (request["requestId"] + ".json"),
                    encoded({"source": selected, "localId": proposed["localId"], "request": request}))
        results = []
        for proposed in preview["reviews"]:
            request = proposed["request"]
            # Native replay checks the original body before version CAS. Any unaccepted
            # stale request stops here; a deliberate fresh preview keeps accepted originals.
            outcome = workspace.perform(request)
            receipt = {"request": request, "result": outcome["result"]}
            publish(root / "results" / (request["requestId"] + ".json"), encoded(receipt))
            results.append({"localId": proposed["localId"], "requestId": request["requestId"],
                            "reviewId": outcome["result"]["reviewId"]})
        result = {"schema": "commons.audit-recipient-accepted.v1", **selected,
                  "operator": preview["operator"], "reviews": results}
        publish(root / "ACCEPTED.json", encoded(result)); return result

def main(argv=None):
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    sub = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True)
    p = sub.add_parser("prepare"); p.add_argument("--archive", required=True); p.add_argument("--out", required=True)
    p = sub.add_parser("pack"); p.add_argument("--archive", required=True); p.add_argument("--draft", required=True); p.add_argument("--out", required=True)
    for name in ("preview", "apply"):
        p = sub.add_parser(name); p.add_argument("--return", dest="returned", required=True)
        p.add_argument("--workspace", required=True)
        if name == "preview": p.add_argument("--operator", required=True); p.add_argument("--out", required=True); p.add_argument("--journal")
        else: p.add_argument("--preview", required=True); p.add_argument("--journal", required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    if args.command == "prepare": result = prepare(args.archive, args.out)
    elif args.command == "pack": result = make_return(args.archive, args.draft, args.out)
    else:
        from workspace import Workspace
        directory = Path(args.workspace)
        require((directory / "audit-exchange.sqlite").is_file(), "recipient_workspace",
                "Open the existing original Audit workspace; do not create a new destination.")
        workspace = Workspace(directory)
        if args.command == "preview":
            result = plan(workspace, args.returned, args.operator, args.journal); publish(args.out, encoded(result))
        else: result = apply(workspace, args.returned, args.preview, args.journal)
    print(canonical(result))
    return 0

if __name__ == "__main__":
    try: raise SystemExit(main())
    except AuditError as error:
        print(canonical({"ok": False, "error": {"code": error.code, "message": str(error),
                                             "details": error.details}}))
        raise SystemExit(1)
